text: Ka Mantaha, borasaense ho tswa Stanford University School of Medicine ba phatlaladitse ho thakgolwa ha sesebediswa se setjha sa phumano ya mafu se ka kgethollang disele ho latela mofuta: tjhipi e nyane e kgonang ho porintwa e ka etswa ho sebediswa diprintara tsa tlwaelo tsa "inkjet" bakeng sa tjeo e ka etsang sente e le nngwe ya U.S. ho porinta ka hong.
text_en: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: Bafuputsi ba eteletseng pele ba re sena se ka tlisa phumano e ntjha e sa le qalong haholo bakeng sa kankere, lefuba, HIV le malaria bakuding ba dinaheng tse nang le moruo o tlase, moo dikgahla tsa ho pholoha bokuding bo jwalo ka kankere ya letswele e ka bang halofo ya dinaheng tse ruileng.
text_en: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: Sefofane sa JAS 39C Gripen se ile sa swahlamana tseleng ya sona ha nako e ka ba 9:30 am ka nako ya lehae (0230 UTC) mme sa phatloha, e leng se bakileng ho kwalwa ha boemafofane bakeng sa difofane tsa baeti.
text_en: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: Mofofisi o tsebahaditswe ka hore ke Moetapele wa Squadron Dilokrit Pattavee.
text_en: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.

text: Ditlaleho tsa masedinyana a lehae di re setima-mollo sa boemafofane se ile sa phethoha ha sene se phallela koduwa ena.
text_en: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.

text: Vidal ya dilemo tse 28 o kenetse sehlopha sa Barça dihleng tse tharo tse fetileng, ho tswa Sevilla.
text_en: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.

text: Haesale a fallela motsemoholong wa Catalan, Vidal o bapetse dipapadi tse 49 bakeng sa tlelapa.
text_en: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.

text: Boipelaetso bo qadile ha nako ya lehae e ka ba 11:00 (UTC+1) mane Whitehall e tobaneng le monyako o lebetsweng ke mapolesa o Downing Street, e leng bodulo ba semmuso ba Tonakgolo.
text_en: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Nakwana kamora 11:00, baipelaetsi ba thibetse sephethephethe se tseleng e lebileng leboya e leng Whitehall.
text_en: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: Ka 11:20, mapolesa a kopile baipelaetsi ho tjhetjhela peifementeng, ba bolela hore ba lokela ho lekalekanya tokelo ya ho ipelaetsa le thibello ya sephethephethe.
text_en: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Ha nako e ka ba 11:29, baipelaetsi ba nyolohetse tseleng ya Whitehall, ba feta Trafalgar Square, ba tsamaya ka tsela ya Strand, ho ya feta Aldwych le ho nyolosa Kingsway ba lebile Holborn moo mokga wa Conservative Party o neng o tshwere Foramo ya Selemo ya bona hoteleng ya Grand Connaught Rooms.
text_en: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

text_en: Nadal's head to head record against the Canadian is 7–2.

text_en: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."

text: "Panama Papers" ke lentswe la pokeletso bakeng sa ditokomane tse fetang dimilione tse leshome ho tswa khampaning ya tsa molao ya Panama Mossack Fonseca, e senotsweng masedinyaneng sehleng sa selemo ka 2016.
text_en: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: Ditokomane tsena di bontshitse hore dibanka tse leshome le metso e mene di thusitse ditlelaente tsa tsona tsa barui ho pata dibilione tsa didolara tsa Amerika hore ba qobe ho lefiswa lekgetho le melawana e meng.
text_en: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: Koranta ya Borithani The Guardian e boletse hore Deutsche Bank e laola ho ka bang karolo ya nngwe borarong ya dikhampani tsa robaditsweng ("shell company") tse 1200 tse sebediswang ho fihlella sena.
text_en: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

text: Ho bile le boipelaetso lefatsheng ho pota lefatshe, diqoso tse mmalwa tsa tlolo ya molao, mme baetapele ba mebuso ya dinaha tsa Iceland le Pakistan ka bobedi ba itokolotse mosebetsing.
text_en: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.

text: O hlahetse Hong Kong, Ma o ithutile New York University le Harvard Law School mme o kile a ba le karete ya modudi wa nako yohle wa Amerika ("green card").
text_en: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

text: Hsieh o boletse nakong ya dikgetho hore Ma a ka nna a baleha naheng ka nako ya tlokotsi.
text_en: Hsieh implied during the election that Ma might flee the country during a time of crisis.

text: Hsieh hape o itse ka Ma, ya ratang difoto "ha ho kwae komeng".
text_en: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.

text: Ho sa natswe diqoso tsena, Ma o hapile ka bokgabane sethaleng se kgothaletsang maqhama a katamelano le mmuso o moholo wa naha ya China.
text_en: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

text: Sebapadi sa Letsatsi sa Kajeno ke Alex Ovechkin wa Washington Capitals.
text_en: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.

text: O hlabile dintlha tse 2 le dithuso dintlheng tse 2 tlholong ya bona ya Washington ya dintlha tse 5-3 kgahlanong le Atlanta Thrashers.
text_en: He had 2 goals and 2 assists in Washington's 5-3 win over the Atlanta Thrashers.

text: Thusetso ya pele ya Ovechkin ya phirimana e bile ntlheng e hapileng papadi e hlabilweng ke Nicklas Backstrom;

text: ntlha ya hae ya bobedi bosiung boo e bile ya bo-60 sehleng sa dipapadi, moo a bileng sebapadi sa pele ho hlaba dintlha tse 60 kapa ho feta sehleng haesale ho tloha ka 1995-96, moo Jaromir Jagr le Mario Lemieux ba fihletseng sehlohlolo sena sebapadi ka seng.

text_en: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.

text_en: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.

text: Tjhankana e tumme ka lebitso le lebe kamora hore tlhekefetso ya motshwaruwa e sibollwe teng kamora hore mabotho a naha ya US a e hape.
text_en: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

text: Piquet Jr. o thutse lebelong la ka 2008 la Singapore Grand Prix kamora kgefu ya "pit stop" ho ema e sa le qalong ha Fernando Alonso, e leng se tlisitseng koloi ya polokeho.
text_en: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.

text: Ha makoloi a kapele ho Alonso a ya ho tshela mafura tlasa koloi ya polokeho, o ile a fetela kapele ho sehlotshwana sena ho ikgapela tlholo.
text_en: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: Piquet Jr. o ile a tebelwa kamora mojaho wa 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.
text_en: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: Hantle ka 8:46 a.m. kgutso ya aparela toropokgolo, e leng hantle nako eo sefofane sa pele se thutseng pakane ya sona.
text_en: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

text: Mabone a mabedi a hlonngwe ho sheba lehodimo bosiu.
text_en: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

text: Kaho e a tswella bakeng sa meaho ya mafaufau e mehlano e metjha setsing sena, moo ho nang le setsi sa dipalanngwang le paraka ya sehopotso kgubung ya sona.
text_en: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.

text: Lenaneo la PBS le na le dikgau tse fetang mashome a mabedi a metso e mene, mme tsamaiso ya lona e kgutshwane ho feta feela Seterata sa Sesame le Motseng wa Monghadi Rogers.
text_en: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: Karolo kanngwe ya lenaneo e lebisa tlhokomelo ho sehlooho se bukeng e itseng mme ho atoloswe sehloooho seo ka dipale tse ngata.
text_en: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text: Lenaneo ka leng le fana ka dibuka tse kgothalletswang tseo bana ba lokelang ho di batla ha ba e ya laebrari.
text_en: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: John Grant, ya tswang WNED Buffalo (Seteishene sa Reading Rainbow) o re "Reading Rainbow e rutile bana hore hobaneng ba lokela ho bala,… lerato la ho bala — [lenaneo] le kgothalleditse bana ho nka buka mme ba bale."
text_en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Ba bang ba dumela, ho akarelletsa le John Grant, hore ka bobedi ba fanang ka ditjhelete le ho fetoha ha filosofi ya mananeo a thelevishene a rutang ho tlatseditse ho fedisweng ha lenaneo.
text_en: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Sefefo, se ka bang bohole ba dimmaele tse 645 (1040 km) ka bophirima ho dihlekehleke tsa Cape Verde, se na le monyetla wa hore se tla fela pele se ka tshosetsa dibaka dife kapa dife tse ka hare ho naha, ho rialo ba tsa bolepi.
text_en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Sefefo sa Fred hajwale se na le meya ya lebelo la dimmaele tse 105 ka hora (165 km/h) mme se lebile ka leboya bophirima.
text_en: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Fred ke saetlelone ya ditropiking e matla ka ho fetisisa e kileng ya rekotwa ka borwa le botjhabela hakana lewatleng la Atlelantiki haesale ho tloha qalehong ya ditshwantsho tsa sathalaete, mme ke ya boraro ka boholo e rekotilweng ka botjhabela ba 35°W.
text_en: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Ka la 24 Lwetse, 1759, Arthur Guinness o saenne lisi ya dilemo tse 9,000 bakeng sa St James' Gate Brewery e leng Dublin, Ireland.
text_en: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: Dilemo tse 250 ha morao, Guinness e hodile ho ba kgwebo ya lefatshe lohle e fihlellang tjhelete e kahodimo ho 10 bilione ya di-euro (US$14.7 dibilione) selemo se seng le se seng.
text_en: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Jonny Reid, e leng mphato wa baqhobi ba A1GP ba sehlopha sa New Zealand, kajeno o entse histori ka ho qhoba ka lebelo le fetisisang ha a tshela Borokgo bo dilemo tse 48 ba Auckland Harbour, mane New Zealand, ka molao.
text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Mong Reid o kgonne ho qhoba koloi ya A1GP ya New Zealand, Black Beauty ka mabelo a ka hodimo ho 160km/h makgetlo a supileng hodima borokgo bona.
text_en: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: Mapolesa a New Zealand a fumane bothata ba ho ka sebedisa dithunya tsa bona tsa radar ya lebelo ho bona hore na Mong Reid o palame ka lebelo le lekae ka lebaka la ka moo Black Beauty e manameng fatshe ka teng, mme lekgetlo le le leng leo mapolesa a kgonneng ho fumana lebelo la Mong Reid ke ha a fokoletsa lebelo la koloi ya hae ho 160km/h.
text_en: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Nakong ya dikgwedi tse 3 tse fetileng, batho ba fetang 80 ba tshwerwe le ho lokollwa ho tswa Setsing sa Batshwaruwa ntle le hore ba qoswe semolao.
text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Ka Mmesa selemong sena, taelo ya nakwana ya thibelo e fanwe ke Moahlodi Glynn kgahlanong le setsi sena hore se phethahatse tokollo ya batho ba neng ba tshwerwe nako e fetang dihora tse 24 kamora ho tshwarwa ha bona mme ba sa mamelwa ke mokhomishenara wa lekgotla kamora moo.
text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Mokhomishenara o teka beile, haeba e fanwa, mme o tiisa semolao diqoso tse hlahletsweng ke moofisiri ya tshwereng batho. Diqoso tsena jwale di kenngwa sistiming ya dikhomphuta ya naha moo qoso e tla latelwa.
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: Hape ho mamelwa hona ho theha letsatsi la tokelo ya mmelaellwa ya ho fumana nyewe ka potlako.
text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Peter Costello, e leng letona la ditjhelete la Australia le monna ya lebeletsweng haholo hore o tla hlahlama Tonakgolo John Howard jwalo ka moetapele wa mokga wa ma-Liberal o fane ka tshehetso ya hae bakeng sa phehlo ya motlakase ya nyutlelia naheng ya Australia.
text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Mong Costello o itse ha phehlo ya nyutlelia e ba le kgonahalo ho tsa moruo, Australia e tlameha ho latela tshebediso ya yona.
text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: "Haeba e amohelwa kgwebong, re tlameha ho ba le yona. Ke hore, ha ho kganyetso e nang le mabaka ho phehlo ya motlakase ya nyutlelia" Mong Costello a rialo.
text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: Ho latela Ansa, "mapolesa a ne a ngongorehisitswe ke dipolao tsa batho ba maemo a phahameng tseo ba tshabileng hore di ka baka ntwa e feletseng ya bohlahlami.
text_en: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: Sepolesa se itse Lo Piccolo o ne a itlhomme pele hobane e ne e le letsoho le letona la Provenzano mane Palermo mme boiphihlelo ba hae bo boholo bo mo hapetse tlhompho hara moloko wa maqheku a baetapele ha ba latela leano la Provenzano la ho dula ba ngotlile mohwasa ka hohle ka moo ba ka kgonang ha ba ntse ba matlafatsa marangrang a bona a matla.
text_en: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text: Baetapele bana ba amohuwe matla ke Provenzano ha a ne a fedisa ntwa e qhojwang ke Riina kgahlanong le profensi ena e nkileng maphelo a diqhoku tsa Mafia Giovanni Falcone le Paolo Borsellino ka 1992."
text_en: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text: Moofisiri wa Sehlooho wa Phethahatso (CEO) wa Apple Steve Jobs o thakgotse sesebediswa ka ho palama sethala le ho ntsha iPhone ka pokothong ya borikgwe ba hae ba dijini.
text_en: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: Nakong ya dihora tse 2 tsa puo ya hae o boletse hore "Kajeno Apple e tla hlahisa botjha founu ena, Re tlo etsa pale kajeno".
text_en: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".

text: Brazil ke naha e kgolo ka ho fetisisa ya bodumedi ba Makhatholiki a Roma Lefatsheng, mme kereke ya Khatholiki ya Roma haesale e hanyetsa kananelo ya molao ya manyalo a batho ba bong bo tshwanang naheng ena.
text_en: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: Ntlo ya Ketsomolao ya Naha ya Brazil e tshohlile ketsomolao ya sena nako ya dilemo tse 10, mme manyalo a jwalo a setjhabeng a molaong feela profensing ya Rio Grande do Sul.
text_en: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: Bili ya motheo e radilwe ke majoro wa mehleng wa São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. Molao o rerilweng, kamora ho hlomathiswa, jwale o matsohong a Roberto Jefferson.
text_en: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: Baipelaetsi ba tshepa ho bokeletsa lengolo la ditletlebo le sainilweng ke batho ba 1.2 milione ho le teka Sebokeng sa Naha ka Pudungwana.
text_en: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: Kamora hore ho bonahale hore malapa a mangata a batla thuso ya molao ho lwantsha ho ntshwa ha bona matlung, kopano e ile ya tshwarwa ka la 20 Hlakubele mane East Bay Community Law Center bakeng sa diphofu tsa boqhekanyetsi ba tsa matlo.
text_en: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Ha badudi ba qala ho arolelana se ba hlahetseng, bongata ba malapa a amehang a qadile ho lemoha hore Carolyn Wilson wa OHA o utswitse didipositi tsa tshireletso tsa bona, mme a balehela sebakeng se seng.
text_en: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Badudi ba Lockwood Gardens ba dumela hore ho ka nna ha ba le malapa a mang a 40 kapa ho feta a tobaneng le ho ntshwa matlung, hobane ba utlwile hore mapolesa a OHA le wona a ntse a fuputsa meaho e meng ya matlo a setjhaba mane Oakland e ka nnang yaba e a ameha boqhekanyetsing ba tsa matlo.
text_en: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: Bente e hlakotse konsarete mane Maui War Memorial Stadium, e neng e reretswe ho ba le batho ba 9,000, mme ya kopa tshwarelo ho balatedi.
text_en: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

text: Khampani ya tsamaiso ya bente, HK Management Inc., ha e a fana ka lebaka la pele ha ba hlakola ka la 20 Lwetse, empa ba hlwaile hore sena se bakilwe ke mabaka a ditlhophiso bakeng sa letsatsi le latelang.
text_en: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: Boramolao ba tummeng ba Magerike, Sakis Kechagioglou le George Nikolakopoulos ba hlahletswe tjhankaneng ya Athens ya Korydallus, kamora ho fumanwa ba le molato wa boqhekanyetsi le bobodu.
text_en: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: Ka lebaka lena, mahlabisa-dihlong a maholo kahare ho setjhaba sa Magerike a hlahisitswe ka ho senolwa ha diketso tse seng molaong tseo baahlodi, boramolao, babuelli ba molao ba phahameng le ba tlase ba di entseng dilemong tse fetileng.
text_en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Dibeke tse mmalwa tse fetileng, kamora hore tlhahisoleseding e phatlalatswe ke moqolotsi wa ditaba Makis Triantafylopoulos lenaneong la hae le tummeng la "Zoungla" ho Alpha TV, setho sa Palamente le ramolao, Petros Mantouvalos o nyahladitswe ha ditho tsa ofisi ya hae di ameha ketsong ya boqhekanyetsi le bododu.
text_en: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Ho feta mono, moahlodi ya phahameng Evangelos Kalousis o hlahletswe tjhankaneng ha a ne a fumanwa a le molato wa bobodu le boitshwaro bo hlephileng.
text_en: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Roberts o hanne a lomahantse meno ho bolela hore na o dumela hore bophelo bo qalehile neng, e leng potso ya bohlokwa ha ho nahanwa ka tsa nepahalo ya ho ntsha mpa, moo a itseng ho keke ha tshwaneleha ho hlahisa maikutlo mabapi le dintlha tse keneletseng tsa diketsahalo tse ka amehang.
text_en: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: Leha ho le jwalo, o thathiseleditse polelo ya hae ya pejana ya hore kahlolo ya Roe v. Wade ke "molao o phethahetseng wa naha", a thathiseletsa bohlokwa ba dikahlolo tse tshehetsanang tsa Lekgotla le Phahameng.
text_en: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: Hape o tiisitse hore o dumela tokelong ya sephiri e amehang eo kahlolo ya Roe e itshetlehileng hodima yona.
text_en: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

text_en: While authorities are unsure of the credibility of the threat, the Maryland Transportaion Authority made the closure with the urging of the FBI.

text: Dilori tsa matlakala di sebedisitswe ho thibela menyako ya tjhubu mme thuso mapolesa a 80 e ne e fumaneha bakeng sa ho laola sephethephethe sa makoloi ho a kgelosa.
text_en: Dump trucks were used to block tube entrances and assistance of 80 police were on hand to direct motorists to detours.

text: Ha ho a ba le ditiehiso tsa sephethephethe se boima tse tlalehilweng tseleng e kgolo (beltway), tsela e nngwe ya toropokgolo.
text_en: There were no heavy traffic delays reported on the beltway, the city's alternate route.

text: Nigeria e phatlaladitse pejana hore e rerile ho kenela AfCFTA bekeng e eteletseng pele seboka sena.
text_en: Nigeria previously announced it planned to join the AfCFTA in the week leading up to the summit.

text: Mokhomishenara wa kgwebo le dindasteri wa AU Albert Muchanga o phatlaladitse hore Benin e tla e kenela.
text_en: AU trade and industry commissioner Albert Muchanga announced Benin was to join.

text: Mokhomishenara o itse, "Ha re eso ka re dumellana mabapi le melawana ya ho thehwa le dinyehlisetso tsa ditharife, empa moralo oo re nang le wona o lekane ho qala kgwebisano ka la 1 Phupu, 2020".
text_en: The commissioner said, "We haven't yet agreed on rules of origin and tariff con[c]essions, but the framework we have is enough to start trading on July 1, 2020".

text: Seteishene se tswelletse ka althitute ya sona, ho sa natswe tahlehelo ya gyroscope pejana leetong la seteisheneng sa sepakapaka, ho fihlela qetello ya ho tsamaya sepakapakeng.
text_en: The station maintained its attitude, despite the loss of a gyroscope earlier in the space station mission, until the end of the spacewalk.

text: Chiao le Sharipov o tlalehile ho ba bohole bo bolokehileng ho tswa ho disututsi tsa tekanyo ya boikutlo (attitude adjustment thrusters).
text_en: Chiao and Sharipov reported being a safe distance from the attitude adjustment thrusters.

text: Taolo ya fatshe ya Russia e thakgotse difofane tsa dijete mme boikutlo ba tlwaelo ba seteishene ba fumanwa botjha.
text_en: Russian ground control activated the jets and normal attitude of the station was regained.

text: Nyewe e ile ya tjhotjhiswa mane Virginia hobane ke lehae la mofani wa inthaneteng ya eteletseng pele AOL, e leng khampani e rerileng ditefiso tsena.
text_en: The case was prosecuted in Virginia because it is the home to the leading internet service provider AOL, the company who instigated the charges.

text: Lena ke lekgetlo la pele moo kahlolo e fumanweng ka ho sebedisa molao o fetisitsweng ka 2003 ho thibela imeile e ngata, e leng se bitswang spam, e romelwang ntle le kopo ho di-mailbox tsa basebedisi.
text_en: This is the first time a conviction has been gained using the legislation enacted in 2003 to curb bulk e-mail, aka spam, from unsolicited distribution into users mailboxes.

text: Jesus ya dilemo tse 21 o kenetse Manchester City selemong se fetileng ka Pherekgong selemong se fetileng ka 2017 ho tswa tlelapeng ya Brazil e bitswang Palmeiras ka theko e tlalehilweng ya £27 milione.
text_en: 21-year-old Jesus joined Manchester City last year in January 2017 from Brazilian club Palmeiras for a reported fee of £27 million.

text: Haesale ho tloha mona, moBrazil enwa o bapetse dipapading tse 53 bakeng sa tlelapa ena ditlhodisanong tsohle mme o hlabile dintlha tse 24.
text_en: Since then, the Brazilian has featured in 53 matches for the club in all competitions and has scored 24 goals.

text: Ngaka Lee hape o hlahisitse ngongoreho ya hae e mabapi le ditlaleho tsa hore bana ba Turkey jwale ba tshwaeditswe ke vaerase ya mokgohlane wa dinonyana ya A(H5N1) ntle le ho kula.
text_en: Dr. Lee also expressed his concern about reports that children in Turkey have now become infected with the A(H5N1) avian influenza virus without becoming ill.

text: Diphuputso ts ding di hlahisitse hore lefu lena le tlameha ho se be le kotsi e kgolo pele le ka baka sewa sa lefatshe lohle, a bolela jwalo.
text_en: Some studies suggest that the disease must become less lethal before it can cause a global epidemic, he noted.

text: Ho na le ngongoreho ya hore bakudi ba ka nna ba tswela pele ho tshwaetsa batho ba bang ka ho phetha mesebetsi ya bona ya letsatsi le letsatsi haeba matshwao a ho kula a mokgohlane a dula a le bobebe.
text_en: There is concern that patients may continue to infect more people by going through their daily routines if the flu symptoms remain mild.

text: Leslie Aun, sebui bakeng sa Komen Foundation, o itse mokgatlo o thehile molawana o motjha o sa dumelleng dikerante kapa tshehetso ya tjhelete hore e fanwe ho mekgatlo e tlasa diphuputso tsa molao.
text_en: Leslie Aun, a spokesperson for the Komen Foundation, said the organization adopted a new rule that does not allow grants or funding to be awarded to organizations that are under legal investigation.

text: Leano la Komen le bolaile matla a mokgatlo wa Thero ya Malapa ka lebaka la phuputso e tswellang e mabapi le ka moo Thero ya Malapa e sebedisang le ho tlaleha ditjhelete tsa wona e tsamaiswang ke Moemedi Palamenteng Cliff Stearns.
text_en: Komen's policy disqualified Planned Parenthood due to a pending investigation on how Planned Parenthood spends and reports its money that is being conducted by Representative Cliff Stearns.

text: Stearns o fuputsa hore na makgetho a sebediswa bakeng sa ho tshehetswa ho ntshwa ha dimpa tshebetsong ya hae jwalo ka modulasetulo wa Bodisa le Komiti e Nyane ya Dipatlisiso, e tlasa sekgurumetso sa Komiti ya Eneji le Kgwebo ya Ntlo ya Baemedi ya Palamente.
text_en: Stearns is investigating whether taxes are used to fund abortions through Planned Parenthood in his role as chairman of the Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, which is under the umbrella of the House Energy and Commerce Committee.

text: Mmusisi wa mehleng wa Massachusetts Mitt Romney o hapile dikgetho tsa motheo tsa Mokga wa Mariphabolikene wa Florida ka Labobedi ka ho hapa diphesente tse 46 tsa divoutu.
text_en: Former Massachusetts governor Mitt Romney won the Florida Republican Party presidential primary election on Tuesday with over 46 percent of the vote.

text: Sepikara sa mehleng sa Ntlo ya Baemedi ya Palamente ya naha ya U.S. Newt Gingrich se hlahile bobeding ka diphesente tse 32.
text_en: Former U.S. Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich came in second with 32 percent.

text: Jwalo ka profensi eo ho yona mohlodi a hapang tsohle, Florida e abetse bakgethwa bohle ba yona ba mashome a mahlano ho Romney, e leng se mo sutuleditseng ka pele ho moetapele bakeng sa thonyo ya Mokga wa Mariphabolikene.
text_en: As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.

text: Bahlophisi ba boipelaetso ba itse mabapi le batho ba 100,000 ba tlileng ditoropokgolong tsa Jeremane jwalo ka Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, le Hanover.
text_en: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover.

text: Berlin, mapolesa a ile a hakahanya batho ba entseng seteraeke ba 6,500.
text_en: In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors.

text: Diteraeke di entswe hape le Paris, Sofia e leng Bulgaria, Vilnius e leng Lithuania, Valetta e leng Malta, Tallinn e leng Estonia, le Edinburgh hammoho le Glasgow e leng Scotland.
text_en: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.

text: London, batho ba ka bang 200 ba ne ba entse seteraeke kantle ha diofisi tsa batshwari ba ditokelo tsa bongodi ba ka sehloohong.
text_en: In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices.

text: Kgwedi e fetileng, ho ne ho e na le diteraeke tse kgolo Poland ha naha eo e saena ACTA, ho bakileng hore mmuso wa Mapolishe o nke qeto ya ho se amohele tumellano, ha jwale.
text_en: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.

text: Latvia le Slovakia ka bobedi di diehisitse tshebetso ya ho kenela ACTA.
text_en: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.

text: Mokgatlo wa Tokoloho ya Diphoofolo le Mokgatlo wa Botlotlehi wa Thibelo ya Tshotlo ya Diphoofolo (Animal Liberation) le Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) hape e ipiletsa bakeng sa ho kenngwa ka tlamello ha dikhamera tsa CCTV dilakgapaneng tsohle tsa Australia.
text_en: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

text: Hlooho ya RSPCA New South Wales inspektara David O'Shannessy o jwetsitse ABC hore bodisa le ditlhahlobo tsa dilakgapane di tlameha ho atiswa naheng ya Australia.
text_en: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

text: "CCTV e tla feela e romele letshwao le matla ho batho ba sebetsang ka diphoofolo hore tshwaro ya tsona e ntle ke taba ya bohlokwa bo phahameng ka ho fetisisa."
text_en: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

text: Mmapa wa United States Geological Survey wa matjhaba wa tshisinyeho ya lefatshe ha wa ka wa bontsha ho bile le ditshisinyeho tsa lefatshe Iceland beke pele ho moo.
text_en: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.

text: Ofisi ya Icelendic Meteorological le yona e ile ya tlaleha ho se na tshisinyeho ya lefatshe e bileng teng tikolohong ya Hekla dihoreng tse 48 tse fetileng.
text_en: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.

text: Ketsahalo ya tshitshinyeho ya lefatshe e ikgethileng e lebisitseng ho tjhentjheng ha sebopeho e etsahetse ka la 10 Hlakubele ka borwabophirima ba thaba ya seretse se tjhesang e entse mokoti o moholo qhoweng.
text_en: The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera.

text: Maru a matsho a neng a sa amahanywe le ketsahalo ya ho foqoha ha seretse se tjhesang a ile a tlalehwa mesikong ya thaba.
text_en: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.

text: Maru a ile a etsa hore ho be le pherekano ya hore na ehlile ho foqoha ho jwalo ho ile ha etsahala.
text_en: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text: Luno e ne e tshetse dikhubiki mitara tse 120–160 tsa mafura ha e robeha mme meya le maqhubu tse matla di e sutuletsa kgaolong ya metsi.
text_en: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

text: Dihelikoptara di pholositse ditho tsa boqhobi ba sekepe tse leshome le metso e mmedi mme temalo e le nngwe feela e bile nko e robehileng.
text_en: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

text: Sekepe sena sa dimitara tse 100 se ne se le leetong la ho ya lata morwalo wa sona wa tlwaelo wa manyolo mme qalong baofisiri ba ne ba tshohile hore sekepe se ka qhala morwalo ona.
text_en: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text: Sehlomathiso se rerilweng se se ntse se fetisitswe ke matlo a mabedi a Palamente ka 2011.
text_en: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

text: Phetoho e entswe sesheneng ena ya ketsamolao moo polelo ya bobedi e hlakotsweng pele ke Ntlo ya Baemedi ya Palamente mme yaba e fetiswa ka sebopeho se tshwanang ke Senate ka Mantaha.
text_en: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.

text: Ho hloleha ha polelo ya bobedi, e rerileng ho thibela manyalo a semmuso dipakeng tsa batho ba bong bo le bong, ho ka nna ha bula monyako bakeng sa manyalo a semmuso kamoso.
text_en: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

text: Kamora tshebetso ena, HJR-3 e tla lekodiswa hape ke ntlo ya ketsomolao ka 2015 kapa 2016 hore e dule e le tshebetsong.
text_en: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

text: Diphihlello tsa Vautier kantle ho laola difilimi di kenyeletsa seteraeke sa ho itima dijo ka 1973 kgahlanong le seo a neng a bona e le thibelo ya sepolotiki.
text_en: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

text: Molao wa Fora o ile wa fetolwa. Bolwanedi ba hae bo kgutletse nakong ya ha a le dilemo tse 15 moo a kenetseng Boitwanelo ba Fora (French Resistance) nakong ya Ntwa ya Bobedi ya Lefatshe.
text_en: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.

text: O itlhalositse bukeng ya 1998.
text_en: He documented himself in a 1998 book.

text: Ka dilemo tsa bo-1960 o ile a kgutlela naheng e neng e sa tswa fumana boipuso ya Algeria ho ya ruta bolaodi ba ditshwantsho.
text_en: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: MoJapane judoka Hitoshi Saito, e leng mohlodi wa dimedale tse pedi tsa kgauta tsa Olimpiki, o shwele a le dilemo tse 54.
text_en: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: Sesosa sa ho shwa ha hae ho phatlaladitswe ka hore ke kankere ya kahara methatswana ya nyooko kahara sebete.
text_en: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: O hlokahaletse Osaka ka Labobedi.
text_en: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: Mmoho le ho ba Mampodi wa mehleng wa Diolimpiki le Lefatshe, Saito e ne e le modulasetulo wa borupelli wa All Japan Judo Federation ka nako ya ho shwa ha hae.
text_en: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: Bonyane batho ba 100 ba kenetse moketjana, e leho keteka sehopotso sa selemo sa pele sa banyalani ba pele bao lenyalo la bona le tshwerweng selemong se fetileng.
text_en: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: Ketsahalo ya semolao ya sehopotso e ne e hlophiseditswe ho ba ka letsatsi la hamorao, ho boletse baofisiri.
text_en: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: Balekane ba ne ba nyalane mane Texas nakong ya selemo se fetileng mme ba tlile Buffalo ho tla keteka le metswalle le beng ba bona.
text_en: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: Monyadi ya dilemo tse 30, ya neng a hlahetse Buffalo, e bile e mong wa batho ba bane ba bolailweng ho thunngweng, empa mohatsae o ne a sa lemala.
text_en: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: Karno ke morupelli ya tsebalang empa wa setumo se seng setle wa Monyesemane ya rutileng tlasa Modern Education le King's Glory ba neng ya itse o ne a na le baithuti ba 9,000 sehlohlolong sa tshebetso ya hae.
text_en: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: Dinoutsung tsa hae o sebedisitse mantswe ao batswadi ba bang ba nkileng a le mabe, mme ho tlalehwa a sebedisitse mahlapa ka phapusing ya thutelo.
text_en: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Thuto ya Sejwalejwale e mo qositse ka ho hatisa dipapatso tse kgolo dibeseng ntle le tumello le ka ho bua leshano ka ho re ke morupelli wa sehlooho wa Senyesemane.
text_en: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Hape o ne a qositswe ka hore o robile molao wa tshireletso ya khopiraete pele ho mona, empa a se ke a qoswa.
text_en: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: Moithuti wa mehleng o itse o sebedisitse 'puo ya seterateng ka phapusing ya thutelo, a ruta ka ditsebo tsa maratano dinoutsung, mme o ne a le jwalo feela ka ' motswalle' wa baithuti.
text_en: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Nakong ya mengwahashome e meraro e fetileng, leha e dutse semmuso e le naha ya bokomonisi, China e thehile moruo wa mebaraka.
text_en: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: Diphetoho tsa pele di bile tlasa boetapele ba Deng Xiaoping.
text_en: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Haesale ho tloha moo, saese ya moruo wa China e hotse ka boikatiso ba makgetlo a 90.
text_en: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Lekgetlo la pele, selemong se fetileng China e rometse ntle makoloi a fetang a Jeremane mme ya feta United States jwalo ka mmaraka o moholo ka ho fetisisa bakeng sa indasteri ena.
text_en: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: GDP ya China e ka ba kgolo ho feta ya United States nakong ya mengwahashome e mmedi.
text_en: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: Sefefo sa Diteropiki sa Danielle, sa bone ho tse rehilweng tsa sehla sa 2010 sa difefo tsa Atlelanthiki, se thomehile Lewatleng la Atlelanthiki ka botjhabela.
text_en: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: Sefefo sena, se bohle bo hakanyetswang ho dimmaele tse 3,000 ho tloha Miami, Florida, se na le meya e phehellang ya bophamo bo fetisisang ba 40 mph (64 kph).
text_en: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Borasaense ba National Hurricane Center ba lepile hore Danielle e tla matlafala ho fihlela boemo ba sefefo sa hurricane ka Laboraro.
text_en: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Hobane sefefo sena se sa le hole le ho fihla naheng, ho sa le thata ho lekanya kgonahalo ya ditlamorao tsa sona naheng ya United States kapa Caribbean.
text_en: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Bobek ya hlahetseng motsemoholo wa Croatia, Zagreb, o fumane setumo ha a bapalla Partizan Belgrade.
text_en: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: O se kenetse ka 1945 mme a ba ho sona ho fihlela ka 1958.
text_en: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Nakong ya hae sehlopheng sena, o hlabile dintlha tse 403 dipapading tse 468.
text_en: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Ha ho eso be le motho ya bileng le dipapadi tse fetang mona kapa ya hlabileng dintlha tse fetang tsena tlelapeng ena ho feta Bobek.
text_en: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: Ka 1995 o voutetswe ho ba sebapadi se hlwahlwa ka ho fetisisa nalaneng ya Partizan.
text_en: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: Diketeko di qadile ka pontsho e kgethehileng ke sehlopha se tummeng lefatshe lohle sa Cirque du Soleil.
text_en: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: Se latetswe ke Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, bente ya Janissary, le dibini tsa Fatih Erkoç le Müslüm Gürses.
text_en: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Jwale yaba Whirling Dervishes e palama sethala.
text_en: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text_en: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Ho phethela, sehlopha sa tantshi sa Turkey Fire of Anatolia se ile sa bapala pontsho ya "Troy".
text_en: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Peter Lenz, e leng sepalamisa mejaho ya dithuthuthu se dilemo tse 13, o shwele kamora hore a amehe kotsing ya thulano mane Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
text_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Ha a ntse a le lekgeng la boikwetliso ba hae, Lenz a wa sethuthuthung sa hae, mme yaba o thulwa ke mopalami e mong wa mohlodisani Xavier Zayat.
text_en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: O ile a hlahlojwa hanghang ke ba bongaka ba lebaleng la mejaho le ho iswa sepetlele se haufinyane moo a ileng a shwa ha morao.
text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat o ne a sa lemala kotsing ena.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Mabapi le boemo ba tsa ditjhelete ba matjhaba, Zapatero o tswetse pele ka ho re "sistimi ya tsa ditjhelete ke karolo ya moruo, karolo ya bohlokwa.
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Re na le selemo se feletseng sa tlokotsi ya tsa ditjhelete, e bileng le sehlohlolo sa yona nakong ya dikgwedi tse pedi tse fetileng, mme ke nahana hore jwale mebaraka ya tsa ditjhelete e qadile ho imoloha."
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Bekeng e fetileng, Naked News e phatlaladitse hore e tla eketsa ka tsela e kgolo tshebetso ya yona ya phatlalatso ya ditaba ka dipuo tsa matjhaba, ka dikgaso tse tharo tse ntjha.
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: E se ntse e tlaleha ka dipuo tsa Senyesemane le SeJapane, mokgatlo wa lefatshe ho pota o thakgola mananeo a dipuo tsa Spanishe, SeIthali, le SeKorea, bakeng sa thelevishene, webo, le disebediswa tsa mobaele.
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Ka lehlohonolo ha ho letho le etsahetseng ho nna, empa ke bone dipono tsa sehloho tsa masisapelo, ha batho ba leka ho pshatla difenstere hore ba tswe.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Batho ba ne ba otla difenstere ka ditulo empa kgalase ene e sa pshatlehe.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: "E nngwe ya dikgalase ya qetella e pshatlehile, mme ba qala ho tswa ka fenstere," ho rialo lehlatsipa Franciszek Kowal.
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Dinaledi di hlahisa kganya le otjheso ka lebaka la eneji e entsweng ha di-atom tsa haedrojine di kopana (kapa di matahana) mmoho ho theha dielemente tse boima ho feta.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Borasaense ba sebetsang ho theha riektara e ka etsang eneji ka tsela e tshwanang.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Sena, leha ho le jwalo, ke bothata bo boholo haholo ho ka rarollwa mme bo tla nka dilemo tse ngata pele re ka bona kaho ya diriektara tsa matahano e molemo.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Nalete ya tshepe e phaphamala hodima metsi ka lebaka la kgohlano e bokahodimong.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Kgohlano e bokahodimong e etsahala hobane dimolikhule tsa metsi tse bokahodimong ba metsi di hohelana ka matla ho feta ho dimolikhule tse moyeng tse ka hodimo ho tsona.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Dimolikhule di etsa letlalo le sa bonahaleng hodima bokahodimo ba metsi le dumellang dintho tse jwalo ka nalete hore e phaphamale kahodimo ho metsi.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Mofeng wa sekeite sa leqhweng sa sejwalejwale o na le methati e habedi ka sebopeho sa khonkheife se mohohlo dipakeng tsa tsona. Methati e mmedi e dumella tseparelo e matla leqhweng, esita leha o sekame.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Hobane bokatlase ba mofeng bo kobehile hanyane, ha mofeng o sekamela lehlakoreng kapa ho le leng, mothati o thetsang leqhwa le wona o a kobeha.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Sena se etsa hore mopalami wa skeite a thinye. Haeba disekeite di sekamela lehlakoreng le letona, mopalami wa sekeite o thinyetsa lehlakoreng le letona, haeba disekeiti di sekamela lehlakoreng leqeleng mopalami wa sekeiti o tla thinyetsa leqeleng.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Ho kgutlela boemong ba tsona ba eneji ba pele, di tlameha ho tlosa eneji ya tlatsetso eo di e fumaneng ho tswa kganyeng.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Di etsa sena kaho ntsha thokolwana e nyane ya kganya e bitswang "photon".
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Borasaense ba bitsa tshebetso ena "stimulated emission of radiation" hobane di-atom di hlasimollwa ke kganya e matla, e leng se bakang ho ntshwa ha photon ya kganya, mme kganya ke mofuta wa radieishene.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Setshwantsho se latelang se bontsha di-atom tse hlahisang di-photon. Ho hlakile, bonneteng di-photon di nyane haholo ho feta tse setshwantshong.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Di-photon di nyane le ho feta dintho tse entseng di-atom!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Kamora dihora tse makgolokgolo tsa tshebetso filamente e tleloubung e a tjha mme tleloubu ya lebone ha e sa sebetsa.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Tleloubu ya kganya e hloka ho tjhentjhwa. Ho a hlokeha ho ba sedi ha o tjhentjha tleloubu ya lebone.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Sa pele, switjhe bakeng sa lebone e tlameha ho tingwa kapa thapo e hakollwe.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Sena ke hobane motlakase o phallelang soketeng moo karolo ya metale e ya tleloubu e leng teng e ka o tlabola hampe ka motlakase haeba o ka thetsa bokahare ba sokete kapa kutu ya tleloubu ha e sa ntse e kene soketeng hanyane.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Setho sa sehlooho sa sistimi ya potoloho ya madi ke pelo, e pompang madi.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Madi a tloha pelong ka ditjhubu tse bitswang methapo ya madi ya di-artery ebe a kgutlela pelong ka ditjhubu tse bitswang di-vein. Ditjhubu tse nyane ka ho fetisisa di bitswa dikhapilari.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Meno a mofuta wa daenaso e bitswang triceratops a ne a ka kgona ho hlafuna makgasi esita le makala a thata haholo hammoho le metso.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Ditsebi tsa saense di nahana hore di-Triceratops di ne di ja di-cycad, e leng mofuta wa semela o neng o atile mehleng ya boholoholo e bitswang Cretaceous.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Dimela tsena di shebahala jwaloka difate tse nyane tsa dipalema tse nang le korone ya makgasi a ntjhotjho, a hlabang.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Mohlomong Triceratops e ne e hlohlora makgasi pele e ja kutu ka molomo wa yona o matla.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Ditsebi tse ding tsa saense di pheha kgang ya hore dimela tsena di tjhefu haholo, kahoo ha ho utlwahale hore daenaso efe kapa efe e ne e ka di ja, le hoja kajeno bere e nwabolohang e bitswang sloth le diphoofolo tse ding tse kang papakgaeye (eo e leng ledinyane la didaenaso) e ka ja makgasi kapa ditholwana tse tjhefu.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Matla a kgohedi kgweding ya lo e pela Jupiter a ne a ka nkgula hakae? Haeba o ne o ka ema kgweding ya Io, boima ba hao bo ne bo tla fokotseha ha ho bapiswa le ha o le Lefatsheng.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Motho ya boima ba 90kg (diphaonte tse 200) ha a le Lefatsheng o ne a tla ba boima ba 16kg (diphaonte tse 36) ha a le lo. Kahoo ho hlakile hore matla a kgohedi a ne a ke ke a o hula hakaalo.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Letsatsi ha le na lera le ka hodimo jwaloka Lefatshe moo o ka emang teng. Letsatsi kaofela le entswe ka dikgase, mello le plasma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Ha o kenella hare ho tloha kgubung ya Letsatsi, kgase e ba tshesane le ho feta.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Karolo e ka hodimo eo re e bonang ha re sheba Letsatsi e bitswa photosphere, e bolelang “bolo ya kganya”.
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Hoo ekabang dilemo tse dikete tse tharo hamorao, selemong sa 1610, setsebi sa dinaledi sa Motaliana Galileo Galilei se ile sa sebedisa theleskoupo e ileng ya se lemosa hore Venus e na le dibopeho jwalo ka kgwedi.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Dibopeho tsena di hlaha feela hobane lehlakoreng la Venus (kapa la Kgwedi) le shebileng Letsatsi le kgantshitswe. Dibopeho tsa Venus di ne di tshehetsa thuto ya Copernicus hore dipolanete di potoloha Letsatsi.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Yaba dilemo tse seng kae hamorao ka 1639, setsebi sa dinaledi sa Lenyesemane se bitswang Jeremiah Horrocks se ile sa lemoha hore ho na le phetoho ho Venus.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Engelane e ne e bile le nako e telele ya kgotso kamora ho hlolwa hape ha Danelaw.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Leha ho le jwalo ka 991 Ethelred o ile a tobana le Letoto la dipalangwang tsa mabotho le leholo ho feta a mang haesale ho tloha mehleng ya Guthrum mongwahakgolong o fetileng pejana.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Letoto lena la dipalangwang tsa mabotho le ne le eteletswe pele ke Olaf Trygvasson, e leng moNorway ya nang le ditabatabelo tsa ho hapa naha ya habo ho e kgutlisa ho tswa pusong ya Denmark.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Kamora mathata a pele a sesole, Ethelred o ile a kgona ho dumellana ka dipehelo le Olaf, ya ileng a kgutlela Norway ho leka ho fumana borena ba hae ka katleho e sa totobalang.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul ke yona feela alefabeta e qapuweng ka morero e sebediswang letsatsi le letsatsi le e ratwang haholo. Alefabeta ena e ile ya qapuwa ka selemo sa 1444 nakong ya puso ya Morena Sejong (1418 – 1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Morena Sejong e ne e le morena wa bone wa Leloko la Borena la Joseon ebile ke e mong wa marena a hlomphuwang haholo.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Sethathong o ile a reha alafabeta ya Hangeul hore ebe Hunmin Jeongeum, e leng se bolelang “medumo e nepahetseng bakeng sa thupelo ya setjhaba”.
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Ho na le dipale tse ngata tsa hore na Sesanskrit se bile teng jwang. E nngwe ya tsona e amana le ho falla ha Maaryan ho tloha ka bophirimela ho leba India mme a ile a tla le puo ya habo wona.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sesanskrit ke puo ya kgale mme e bapiswa le puo ya Selatine se buuwang Yuropa.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Buka ya kgale ka ho fetisisa e tsejwang lefatsheng e ne e ngotswe ka Sesanskrit. Kamora ho bokellwa ha ditokomane tsa Upanishads, Sesanskrit se ile sa nyamela ka lebaka la maemo a sona papisong le dipuo tse ding.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sesanskrit ke puo e rarahaneng le e nonneng, mme ebile mohlodi wa mantswe a dipuo tse ngata tsa kajeno tsa Seindia, jwalokaha Selatine e le mohlodi wa mantswe a dipuo tsa Seyuropa tse kang Sefora le Sepanishe.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Ha ntwa ya ho tseka Fora e letse, Jeremane e ile ya itokisetsa ho hapa sehlekehleke sa Brithani.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Majeremane a ile a reha tlhaselo eo “Operation Sealion”. Boholo ba dibetsa tse matla le thepa ya Sesole sa Brithani bo ne bo lahlehile ha se tswa Dunkirk, kahoo lebotho le ne le batla le fokola.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Empa Lebotho la Metsing la Brithani kapa Royal Navy le ne le ntse le le matla ho feta Lebotho la Metsing la Jeremane (“Kriegsmarine”) ebile le ne le ka senya dikepe dife kapa dife tse futuhang tse romelwang Kanaleng ya Manyesemane.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Leha ho le jwalo, ke dikepe tse fokolang haholo tsa Lebotho la Metsing la Brithani tse neng di emetse haufi le ditsela tse ka sebediswang ke mabotho a hlaselang a direng kaha baetapele ba lebotho la metsing ba ne ba tshaba hore lebotho la Jeremane la moyeng le hlaselang le ne le tla tebisa dikepe tsa bona.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: A re qale ka tlhaloso ya merero ya Italy. Hantlentle Italy e ne e le “moena” wa Jeremane le Japane.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Lebotho la yona la fatshe le ne le fokola ebile dikepe tsa yona tsa ntwa di se matla, leha e ne e sa tswa haha dikepe tse ntjha tse nne hang pele ntwa e qala.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Italy e ne e amehile haholoholo ka dinaha tsa Afrika. Hore e hape dinaha tseo, e ne e tla hloka ho ba le lebala la difofane tse futuhang, e le hore mabotho a ka tsamaya ka dikepe ho pholletsa le Lewatle la Mediterranean mme la hapa Afrika.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Hore e atleha, e ne e tla lokela ho fedisa dikampo tsa Mabrithani le dikepe tse Egepeta. Ntle ho mehato eo, dikepe tsa ntwa tsa Italy di ne di sa lokela ho etsa ntho efe kapa efe e nngwe.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Jwale a re tle ho Japane. Japane e ne e le naha ya sehlekehleke, jwaloka Brithani.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Disabomarine ke dikepe tse reretsweng ho tsamaya tlasa metsi, mme di dula moo ka nako e telele.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Ho ile ha sebediswa disabomarine Ntweng ya I ya Lefatshe le Ntweng ya II ya Lefatshe. Mehleng eo, di ne di tsamaya butle haholo ebile di ka thunya sebakeng se haufi haholo.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Qalong ya ntwa, di ne di tsamaya haholoholo ka hodima lewatle, empa ha navikeitara ya ditemoso lewatleng e ntse e ntjhafatswa, mme e nepa le ho feta, di sabomarine di ile tsa tlameha ho dula tlasa metsi hore di se ke tsa bonwa.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Disabomarine tsa Majeremane di ne di bitswa di-U-Boat. Majeremane a ne a ipabola ka bosesisi le ho kganna disabomarine tsa bona.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Kaha Majeremane a ile a atleha ho sebedisa disabomarine, kamora ntwa a ne a sa tsheptjwe hore a ka ba le tse ngata.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Ka sebele! Morena Tutankhamun, eo ka dinako tse ding ho thweng ke “Morena Tut” kapa “Morena wa Moshanyana”, ke e mong wa marena a Egepeta a mehleng ya boholoholo a tsejwang haholo mehleng ena.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Ho thahasellisang ke hore, mehleng ya boholoholo o ne a sa nkwe e le motho wa bohlokwa hakaalo ebile o ne a sa tlalehwa mathathamong a mangata a marena a boholoholo.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Leha ho le jwalo, ho sibollwa ha lebitla la hae ka 1922 ho ile ha mo etsa motho ya tummeng. Le hoja ho ile ha utsuwa mabitleng a mangata a kgale, lebitla lena le bonahala le ile la tlohelwa mme ha ho a kenakenanwa le lona.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Boholo ba dintho tseo Tutankhamun a ileng a patwa le tsona di bolokilwe hantle, ho kopanyelletsa le dithulusi le mekgabiso e dikete e entsweng ka ditshepe tsa bohlokwa le majwe a sa tlwaelehang.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Ho qapuwa ha dirimi ho ile ha etsa hore dikoloi tsa ntwa tsa Baassyria di be bobebe, di be lebelo mme di be maemong a matle a ho siya masole le dikoloi tse ding tsa ntwa.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Metsu e hlahang mekorong ya bona e kotsi e ne e ka phunyelletsa diaparo tsa ntwa tsa masole a direng. Hoo ekabang ka 1000 B.C., Baassyria ba ile ba qala sesole sa pele sa dipere.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Sesole sa dipere ke mabotho a lwanang a kaletse dipere. Ho ne ho eso qaptjwe disale, kahoo sesole sa Assyria se ne se lwana se sa beha letho mekokotlong ya dipere.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Re tseba boradipolotiki, borasaense le bataki ba bangata ba Bagerike. Mohlomong motho ya tummeng haholo wa moetlo ona ke Homer, seroki se tummeng se foufetseng, se ileng sa qapa dingolwa tse pedi tse ratwang haholo tsa Segerike: e leng dithothokiso tsa Iliad le Odyssey.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Bangodi ba ntseng ba tumme ba dipapadi tsa kalaneng ke Sophocles le Aristophanes ebile dipapadi tsa bona di balwa hara dibuka tse kgolohadi hara dingolwa tse teng.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Setsebi se seng se tummeng haholo sa dipalo sa Mogerike ke Pythagoras, ya tsejwang haholo ka thuto ya hae ya dikamano tsa mahlakore a dikgutlotharo tse nang le right angle.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Ho na le dikgakanyo tse sa tshwaneng tsa hore na ke batho ba bakae ba buang Sehindi. Ho hakanngwa hore ke puo ya bobedi le ya bone e buuwang ke batho ba bangata haholo lefatsheng.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Palo ya matswallwa a buang puo ena e fapana ho itshetlehile ka hore na ho balwa le batho ba buang mefuta ya puo e haufiufi le puo eo.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Ho hakanngwa hore ke batho ba tlohang ho dimilione tse 340 ho ya ho tse 500 ba buang puo ena, mme batho ba ka bang dimilione tse 800 ba ka utlwisisa puo ena.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Mantswe a puo ya Sehindi le a Seurdu aa tshwana empa a ngolwa ka tsela e sa tshwaneng; hangata dipuisanong tsa letsatsi le letsatsi, batho ba buang dipuo tsena tse pedi baa utlwana.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Hoo ekabang ngwahakgolo wa bo15, karolo e ka leboya ya Estonia e ne e le tlasa tshusumetso ya setso sa Sejeremane.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Banna ba bang ba baitlami ba Majeremane ba ne ba batla ho tlisa Modimo haufi le matswallwa a moo, kahoo ba qapa puo ya Seestonia ya lentswe ka lentswe.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: E ne e thehilwe ho alfabete ya Sejeremane mme ho ile ha kenngwa tlhaku e le nngwe ya "Õ/õ".
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Kamora nako, mantswe a mangata ao e neng e le maadingwa a Sejeremane a ile a amohelwa. Eo ebile qaleho ya kutlwisiso e feletseng.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Ka tlwaelo, mohlahlami boreneng o ne a leba ka kotloloho sesoleng kamora ho qeta sekolo.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Leha ho le jwalo, Charles o ile a ya yunivesithing ya Trinity College, Cambridge moo a ileng a ithuta thuto ya Mahlale a Botho le Kepollo ya Dintho tsa Kgale, mme hamorao a ithuta thuto ya Histori, a fumana 2:2 (e leng degree ya maemo a tlaasana a bobedi).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles ebile setho sa pele sa Lelapa la Boreneng la Brithani sa ho fuwa lengolo la degree.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Karolo ya Turkey e Yuropa (karolo e ka botjhabela ya Thrace kapa Rumelia e hlwahlweng ya Balkan) e nka 3% ya naha.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Naha ya Turkey e bolelele bo fetang dikhilomithara tse 1,600 (1,000 mi) mme e bophara ba 800 km (500 mi), mme e na le sebopeho se matsutlatsutla sa rekthenkele.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Sebaka sa Turkey, ho kopanyelletsa le matsha, se nka disekwere khilomithara tse 783,562 (300,948 sq mi), mme disekwere khilomithara tse 755,688 (291,773 sq mi) di ka borwa bophirimela ho Asia athe disekwere khilomithara tse 23,764 (9,174 sq mi) di Yuropa.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Naha ya Turkey ke ya bo37 ho dinaha tse kgolo ka ho fetisisa lefatsheng, mme e ka nka naha ya Fora le United Kingdom di kopane.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turkey e dikadikeditswe ke lewatle ka mahlakoreng a mararo: Lewatle la Aegean ka bophirimela, lewatle la Black Sea ka leboya le Lewatle la Mediterranean ka borwa.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Naha ya Luxembourg e na le nalane e telele empa e fumane boipuso selemong sa 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Dikarolo tse ding tsa Belgium ya kajeno e ne e le karolo ya Luxembourg nakong e fetileng empa ebile tsa Belgium kamora Phetoho ya Belgium dilemong tsa bo1830.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Haesale Luxembourg e leka ho dula e sa jele paate dintweng tsa ditjhaba tse ding empa e ile ya iphumana e hapuwe ke Jeremane nakong ya Ntwa ya I ya Lefatshe le Ntwa ya II ya Lefatshe.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Ka 1957 Luxembourg e ile ya eba setho se thehang mokgatlo oo kajeno o tsejwang e le Kopano ya Dinaha tsa Yuropa.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong ke qhobosheane e sentsweng le sebaka sa baitlami ba Mabuddha e karolong e kahodimo ya Paro District (Motsaneng wa Phondey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Ho bolelwa hore ka 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel o ile a haha qhobosheane e le ho ikgopotsa tlholo ya hae kgahlanong le mabotho a Tibetan-Mongol.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Ka 1951, ho ile ha qhoma mollo mme ha sala feela diemahale tse ding tse rapelwang tsa Drukgyal Dzong, tse kang setshwantsho sa Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Kamora mollo, qhobosheane ena e ile ya baballwa le ho sireletswa, mme ya sala e le e nngwe ya dibaka tse ratwang haholo ke Mabhuda.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Ka ngwahakgolo wa bo18, Cambodia e ile ya iphumana e qabelletswe dipakeng tsa dinaha pedi tsa boahisani tse matla, e leng Thailand le Vietnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Thailand e ile ya hapa Cambodia ka makgetlo a mmalwa ka ngwahakgolo wa bo18 mme ka 1772 ya ripitla Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Qetellong ya ngwahakgolo wa bo18, Vietnam le yona e ile ya hapa Cambodia.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Mavenezuela a etsang 18% ha a sebetse, mme boholo ba batho ba sebetsang ba hirilwe karolong ya moruo e sa lefisweng lekgetho.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Batho ba babedi ho ba bararo ba Venezuela ba sebetsang ba lekaleng le fanang ka ditshebeletso, hoo ekabang kotara e sebetsa difemeng athe a le mong ho ba bahlano o sebetsa temong.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Indasteri ya bohlokwa ya Venezuela ke oli, hobane naha ena e romela oli e ngata dinaheng tse ding ho feta eo e e rekang, empa ke feela pheresente e le nngwe e sebetsang indastering ya oli.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Ha setjhaba se qeta ho fumana boipuso, boitsebelo ba Singapore Botanic Gardens bo ile ba thusa ho fetola sehlekehleke sena hore ebe Garden City e dibakeng tse futhumetseng tse mongobo.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Ka 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, e leng orchid ya motswako, e ile ya kgethwa e le palesa ya naha e ratwang ke setjhaba.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Selemo le selemo kgweding ya Mphalane diphoofolo tse jang jwang tse ka bang dimilione tse 1.5 di theohela mabalane ka borwa, ebe di tshela Noka ya Mara, di hlaha dihlabeng tse ka leboya ka lebaka la dipula.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Ebe di leba ka leboya hape di se di hlaha ka bophirimela, di boetse di tshela Noka ya Mara, kamora sehla sa dipula ho elella kgweding ya Mmesa.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Lebatoweng la Serengeti ke moo ho nang le Serapa sa Naha sa Diphoofolo sa Serengeti, Sebaka se Sireleditsweng sa Ngorongoro le Sebaka sa Diphoofolo tse Hlaha sa Maswa naheng ya Tanzania athe ha o tshelela ka naheng ya Kenya ke Sebaka sa Naha sa Diphoofolo tse Hlaha sa Maasai Mara.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Ho ithuta ho qapa metjha ya dipuisano ho hloka tsebo ya ho qoqa le ya setso, hammoho ho sebedisa le dithulusi tse tsejwang hantle ditlelaseng tsa ho buisana (ho toroya dipale, ho lokisa modumo le video, ho pheta dipale, jj.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Moralo wa dipuisano o hloka hore o boele o lekole dikgopolo tsa hao ka tlhahiso ya diphatlalatso le ho ithuta ho nahana ka ditsela tse tenyetsehang le maemo.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.
