text: Moralo wa dipuisano o hloka hore dikarolo tsa projeke di kopane, empa hape ebe tse hlakileng ka bomong.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Mathata a dilense tse atametsang setshwantsho ke hore focal complexity le palo ya dikarolo tsa dilense tse hlokahalang ho fihlella boholo ba di-focal length bo feta hole ba di-prime lense.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Bothata bona bo ya bo boba hobane baetsi ba dilense ba fihlella maemo a hodimo haholo tlhahisong ya dilense.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Sena se dumella dilense tsa zoom ho nka dinepe tsa maemo a hodimo ha ho bapiswa le dilense tsa boholo ba sebaka bo tsitsitseng.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Bothata bo bong ba dilense tsa zoom ke hore lebelo le hodimo la dilense hangata le a fokotseha.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Sena se etsa hore ho be thata ho sebedisa dilense tsa zoom tse sa tureng moo lesedi le fokolang ntle le kganya kapa flash.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Bo bong ba mathata a atileng ka ho fetisisa ha o leka ho fetolela ‘movie’ ho fomate ya DVD ke ‘overscan’.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Bongata ba dithelevishene di entswe ka tsela ya ho thabisa setjhaba.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Ka lebaka lena, dintho tsohle tseo o di bonang thelevisheneng di ne di sehilwe meedi, hodimo, tlase le mahlakoreng.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Sena se etsetswa ho netefatsa hore setshwantsho se tlala sekerine kaofela. Sena se bitswa ‘overscan’.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Ka bomadimabe, ha o etsa DVD, mahlakore a yona le wona a ka sehwa jwalo feela, mme haeba vidiyo e na le mengolo-toloki (di-subtitle) e atametseng moedi o tlase, e ke ke ya bontshwa ka botlalo.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Diqhobosheane tse tlwaelehileng tsa mehleng ya boholoholo di etsa hore kelello e nahane ka ditshwantsho tsa dipapadi tsa bakalli ba lwanang ka marumo, mekete le bahlabani ba kaletseng dipaleng tsa Morena Arthur.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Le hara dithako tse seng di qetile dilemo tse sekete, ha ho thata ho utlwa medumo ya dintwa le ho fofonela dintwa tse letseng kgale, ebile ho bonolo ho utlwa medumo ya dipere tsa ntwa di terepela majweng le ho utlwa batho ba thothomela ke tshabo mekoting ya ditjhankana.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Empa na ha re inahanele dintho feela tse siyo? A re qale mona, ke hobaneng ha ho ne ho hahuwa diqhobosheane? Moralo wa tsona o ne o le jwang, hona di ne di hahuwa jwang?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Ho latela mehla eo, Qhobosheane ya Kirby Muxloe e nkwa e le ntlo e tlwaelehileng e sireleditsweng ho fapana le ho ba qhobosheane ya nnete.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Ho ne ho ke ke ha kgoneha hore difensetere tsa yona tsa kgalase le mabota a masesaane a setlele ka nako e telele ha ho hlaselwa ka matla.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Ka bo1480, ha Lord Hastings a qala ho e haha, ho ne ho batla ho na le kgotso mme ho hlokahala tshireletso feela kgahlanong le dihlotshwana tse nyane tsa bafutuhi ba ntseng ba solla.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Tekatekano ya matla e ne e le tsamaiso eo ho yona ditjhaba tsa Yuropa di neng di batla ho boloka bobusi ba ditjhaba tsa dinaha tsohle tsa Yuropa.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Kgopolo e ne e le hore ditjhaba tsohle tsa Yuropa di lokela ho leka ho thibela setjhaba se le seng ho ba matla ka ho fetisisa, mme kahoo mebuso ya ditjhaba e ne e atisa ho fetola dilekane tsa yona e le hore ho dule ho na le tekatekano eo.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Ntwa ya Tlhahlamano ya Borena ba Spain e bile ntwa ya pele eo sesosa se ka sehloohong sa yona e neng e le tekatekano ya matla.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: E tlisitse phetoho ya bohlokwa, kaha dinaha tsa Yuropa di ne di ke ke tsa hlola di ba dintweng tsa boikgakanyo tsa bodumedi. Kahoo Ntwa ya Dilemo tse Mashome a Mararo e ne e tla ba ntwa ya ho qetela e rehwang ntwa ya bodumedi.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Tempele ya Arthemise e Efese e ile ya senngwa ka la 21 Phupu, 356 BCE kapa Pele ho Mehla ya Kreste hobane Herostratus a e tjhesitse.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Ho utlwahala eka o entse ntho ena a susumetswa ke hore o tla tuma. Baefese ba halefileng, ba ile ba phatlalatsa hore lebitso la Herostratus le se ke la tlalehwa ho hang.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Re tena re tseba taba ena tjena hobane rahistori wa Mogerike e leng Strabo o ile a tlaleha lebitso la motho eo. Tempele eo e ile ya senngwa bosiung bo tshwanang le boo Alexander e Moholo a hlahileng ka bona.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexander, jwaloka morena, o ile a kopa ho lefa batho ba tla tsosolosa tempele eo, empa Baefese ba ile ba mo hanyetsa. Hamorao kamora lefu la Alexander, tempele e ile ya tsosoloswa ka selemo sa 323 BCE.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Tiisa hore letsoho la hao le phutholohile kahohle kamoo ho ka kgonehang empa o ntse o tidinya dinoto tsohle ka nepo - hape o leke ho se etsa motsamao o bontshang boikitlaetso ka menwana ya hao.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Ka tsela ena o ke ke wa ikutlwa o kgathetse haholo. Hopola ha ho hlokehe hore o tobetse dikonopo ka thata hore modumo wa piano o utlwahale o phahame haholo.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Ha o letsa korostina, hore o eketse modumo, o sebedisa di-bellow ka ho di hatella kapa ka ho phahamisa lebelo.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Sephiri sa moya ke ho hahamalla puisano le, ho ikamahanya le, kapa ho elellwa le ho lemoha ya teng ka ho sa feleng, bomodimo, nnete ya moya kapa Modimo.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Modumedi o batla ho ba le boiphihlelo ka kotloloho, bonohe, kapa kutlwisiso ya boteng ba modimo kapa medimo.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Balatedi ba hahamalla ditsela tse itseng tsa ho phela, kapa mekgwa e reretsweng ho kgothalletsa boiphihlelo ba mofuta oo.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Bonohe bo ka arolwa ho mefuta e meng ya tumelo ya bodumedi le borapedi ka hore bo hatisa hore motho ka boyena o ba boemong bo ikgethang ba kutlwisiso, haholoholo ba nang le botho bo kgutsitseng, kutlwisiso e tebileng, bo thabileng, kapa esita le ya thabileng.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Bosikhi ke bodumedi bo hlahang India. Bo qadile sebakeng sa Punjab ka ngwahakgolo wa bo15 ho tswa sehlotshwaneng se ikarotseng moetlong wa Bohindu.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Masikh a nka tumelo ya wona e fapane le Bohindu, leha a dumela hore metso ya wona e Sehindung ebile ba sebedisa meetlo ya sona.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Masikh a bitsa bodumedi ba wona Gurmat, e leng Punjabi bakeng sa “tsela ya guru” kapa mosuwe wa bodumedi. Guru ke tshobotsi ya motheo ya madumedi wohle a India empa ho Sesikh, e nkile boemo ba pele jwaloka tumelo e ka sehloohong ya Masikh.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Bodumedi bona bo ile ba thehwa ka ngwahakgolo wa bo15 ke Guru Nanak (1469–1539). Ho ile ha latela tlhahlamano e nngwe ya di-guru tse robong.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Leha ho le jwalo, ka Phupjane 1956, ditshepiso tsa Krushchev di ile tsa lekwa ha meferefere ya Poland, moo basebetsi ba neng ba itseka kgahlanong le kgaello ya dijo le ho fokoletswa meputso, e ileng ya fetoha boitseko kgahlanong le Bokomonisi.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Le hoja qetellong, Krushchev a ile a romela ditanka tsa ntwa ka sepheo sa ho baballa botsitso, o ile a inehela ho dintho tse amanang le moruo tseo batho ba di batlang mme a dumela ho kgetha Wladyslaw Gomulka ya ratwang hore e be tonakgolo e ntjha.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Ntshetsopele Kgohlong ya Indus e ne e le ntshetsopele ya Mehla ya Bronze karolong e ka leboya bophirimela ya India e akaretsang boholo ba Pakistan ya kajeno hammoho le dikarolo tse ding tse ka leboya bophirimela tsa India le ka leboya botjhabela tsa Afghanistan.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Ntshetsopele e ile ya tlokoma kgohlong ya Noka ya Indus e leng moo e nkang lebitso la yona teng.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Le hoja barutehi ba hakanya hore kaha ho ne ho ne ho boetse ho na le ntshetsopele dikgohlong tsa Noka ya Sarasvati eo hona jwale e tjheleng, ka nepo e lokela ho bitswa Ntshetsopele ya Indus-Sarasvati, athe ba bang ba e bitsa Ntshetsopele ya Harappa e reheletsweng ka Harappa, e leng sebaka sa pele moo se ileng sa epollwa ka bo1920.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Hore ebe mmuso wa Roma o ne a amehile ka sesole ho ile ha thusa hore ho ntshetswe pele ditaba tsa bongaka.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Dingaka di ile tsa qala ho thaothwa ke Moemphera Augustus mme tsa theha Masupatsela a Bongaka a Maroma a pele a neng a sebetsa kamora masetlapelo a dintwa.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Dingaka tse buwang di ne di tseba meriana e sa tshwaneng e robatsang e kopanyelletsang morphine e tlotlwang peong ya semela sa poppy le scopolamine e tswang peong ya herbane.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Di ile tsa ba le boitsebelo ba ho kgaola bakudi ditho hore ba se ke ba bolawa ke seso se kekang hammoho le ditsela tsa ho thibela ho tswa madi le ditlelempe tse iketseditsweng tsa ho emisa phallo ya madi.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Dilemong tse makgolo tse latelang, mmuso wa Roma o ile wa atleha haholo lekaleng la meriana mme wa sibolla boholo ba tsebo eo re nang le yona kajeno.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Origami ya Pureland ke origami e nang le thibelo ya hore ke lemeno le le leng feela le ka etswang ka nako, mameno a mang a rarahaneng jwaloka ho mena o kgutlela morao ha aa dumellwa, mme mameno wohle a leba pele feela.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: E ile ya qapuwa ke John Smith dilemong tsa bo1970 ho thusa ditaki tsa mameno tse se nang boiphihelo kapa batho ba sitwang ho tsamaya hantle.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Bana ba ithuta ho lemoha morabe le dintho tse bakang kgethollo ya morabe ba sa le banyane mme dintho tsena tse bakang kgethollo di ama boitshwaro ba bona.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Ka mohlala, bana bao ba ikamahanyang le morabe o monyane o kgethollwang e le o sa sebetseng hantle sekolong hangata ha ba sebetse hantle sekolong hang ha ba ithuta hore na morabe wa bona o tadingwa jwang.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace ke webosaete e maemong a boraro ka ho ratwa e sebediswang naheng ya United States mme e na le diporofaele tse dimilione tse 54 hajwale.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Diwebosaete tsena di hapile maikutlo haholo, haholo boemong ba tsa thuto.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Ho na le dintlha tse ntle tse mabapi le diwebosaete tsena, tse kenyeletsang, ho kgona ho theha leqephe la sehlopha ha bonolo le ka kenyeletsang di-blog, dividiyo, difoto, le ditshebediso tse ding.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Leqephe lena le ka fihlellwa ha bonolo ka ho fana ka aterese ya webo e le nngwe feela, e leng se etsang hore ho be bonolo ho le hopola le ho ba bonolo ho le thaepa bakeng sa baithuti ba ka bang le bothata ka ho sebedisa khiboto kapa mopeleto.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Di ka hlophiswa hore di be bonolo ho baleha mme hape di ka ba le mmala o monyane kapa tsa se be le wona ho latela ka moo ho hlokehang.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Lefu la ho Sitwa ho Tsepamisa Maikutlo (kapa ADD) ke “lefu la methapokutlo le matshwao a mararo a le kgethollang a akarelletsang ho nkeha maikutlo, ho fapoha habonolo ha kelello le ho ba matjato kapa mahlahahlaha ka tsela e feteletseng”.
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Hase kgolofalo ya ho ithuta, empa ke lefu la ho ithuta; le “ama dipheresente tse 3 ho ya ho tse 5 tsa bana bohle, mohlomong bana ba ka bang dimilione tse 2 ba Maamerika”.
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Bana ba tshwerweng ke lena la ADD ba thahafallwa ho tsepamisa mohopolo dinthong tse kang mosebetsi wa sekolo, empa ba ka tsepamisa mohopolo dinthong tseo ba thabelang ho di etsa jwaloka ho bapala kapa ho shebella dipopae tseo ba di ratang kapa ho ngola dipolelo tse se nang matshwao a kang kgutlo le felwane.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Hangata bana bao ba kena mathateng a mangata, hobane ba “etsa dintho tse kotsi, ba dulela ho lwana, ebile ba phephetsa bolaodi” ka sepheo sa ho hlasimolla kelello, hobane dikelello tsa bona di ke ke tsa hlasimollwa ka mekgwa e tlwaelehileng.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: ADD e ama dikamano tsa bana le dithaka tsa bona hobane bana ba bang ha ba utlwisise hore na ke hobaneng ha bana bao ba etsa dintho jwalo kapa hore na ke hobaneng ha ba peleta ka tsela eo ba etsang ka yona kapa hore kgolo ya bona ha e tshwane le ya ba bang.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Ha bokgoni ba ho fumana tsebo le ho ithuta bo fetoha ka tsela e boletsweng ka hodimo, sekgahla sa motheo seo motho a ka fumanang tsebo e jwalo ka sona boa fetoha.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Tsela ya ho fumana tlhahisoleseding e ne e fapane. Motho ha a sa na kgatello ya ho hopola, empa bokgoni ba ho hopola sengolwa e bile yona ntho eo ho amehilweng ka yona.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Hantlentle, Renaissance (Tsosoloso) e entse phetoho e kgolo tseleng ya ho ithuta le ya ho aba tsebo.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Ho fapana le diphoofolo tsa di-primate, diphoofolo tsa di-hominids ha di sa sebedisa matsoho a tsona ho tsamaya kapa ho jara boima kapa ho qhoma difateng.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Matsoho le maoto a chimpanzi aa lekana ka boholo le bolelele, se bontshang hore matsoho a sebedisetswa ho jara boima ha e tsamaya ka dinoko.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Letsoho la motho le lekgutshwane ho feta leoto, mme masapo a menwana a batla a otlolohile.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Masapo a matsoho mesaletseng ya dintho tsa kgale a dilemo di dimilione tse pedi ho isa ho dimilione tse tharo a bontsha phetoho ya tsela ya ho sebedisa letsoho, ha a sa sebedisetswa motsamao empa a sebedisetswa ho tshwara.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Batho ba bang ba dumela hore ho baka ditoro tseo ho tsona motho a utlwang hore o ntse a lora ekaba ntho e kgathatsang haholo.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Lebaka le ka sehloohong la ketsahalo ena le bakwa ke ditoro tseo motho a ikutlwang ho tsona e leng se eketsang nako pakeng tsa boemo ba ho robala o ntse o panyapanya (kapa REM).
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Haeba o ba le dinako tsa REM tse fokolang bosiu ka bong, boemo bona boo o hlileng o robetseng ka bona mme mmele wa hao o iphumana ka ditsela tse sa tlwaelehang hoo seo ekabang bothata.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Ena ke ntho e kgathatsang jwalokaha eka o ne o tsoha kamora metsotso e meng le e meng e mashome a mabedi kapa mashome a mararo hore o shebelle TV.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Ditlamorao di tla itshetleha ka hore na ke ka makgetlo a makae boko bo ileng ba leka ho lora empa o ntse o lemoha se etsahalang bosiu ka bong.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Dintho ha di a tsamaela Mataliana hantle mane Afrika Leboya ho batlang e le ho tloha qalong. Nakong ya beke kamora phatlalatso ya ntwa ke Italy ka la 10 Phupjane, 1940, lebotho la Borithani la bo-11 la Hussar le hapile Fort Capuzzo mane Libya.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Tlhaselong ya ho tsometsa ka botjhabela ba Bardia, Maborithani a hapile Moenjineri wa Sehlooho wa Ithali ya Maemong a Leshome Lebothong la Fatshe, Mojenerale Lastucci.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Ka la 28 Phupjane, Marshal Italo Balbo, Mmusisi-Kakaretso wa Libya le mohlahlami wa Mussolini, o ile a bolawa ke dikulo tse tswang ho lebotho la habo ha ba ne ba tsorama ka sefofane Tobruk.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Papadi ya kajeno ya ho lwana ka disabole e bapalwa ditekanyetsong tse ngata, ho tloha ho diithuti tse ithutang univesithing ho ya ho tlhodisano ya ditsebi le ya Diolimpiki.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Papadi ena ka ho kgetheha e bapalwa ka mokgwa wa ho lwantshana pakeng tsa batho ba babedi, motho a le mong ya tshwereng sabole a lwantsha e mong.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Kolofo ke papadi eo ho yona dibapadi di sebedisang melamu hore di otle dibolo di kene ka hare ho dikoti.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Ho bapalwa dikoti tse mashome le metso e robedi papading e tlwaelehileng, ha dibapadi di qala sekoting sa pele lebaleng mme di qetella ka sa bo mashome le metso e robedi.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Sebapadi se otlang makgetlo a mmalwa, kapa ho bilikisa molamu, hore a qete papadi ke yena ya hlolang.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Papadi e bapallwa hodimo ha jwang, mme jwang bo leng haufi le mokoti bo kutiwa bo be bokgutswanyuane mme bo bitswa the green.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Mohlomong mofuta o tlwaelehileng haholo wa bohahlaudi ke seo batho ba se amahanyang le ho nka leeto: Bohahlaudi ba Boikgathollo.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Sena ke ha batho ba ya sebakeng se fapaneng le bophelo ba bona ba letsatsi le letsatsi hore ba phomole le ho ithabisa.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Mabopo a lewatle, dirapa tsa boithabiso le mabala a dikampo ke tsona dibaka tse tlwaelehileng haholo tseo bahahlaudi ba boikgathollo ba ratang ho di etela.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Haeba sepheo sa motho sa ho etela sebaka se itseng ke ho tseba histori le setso sa yona jwale mofuta wa bohahlaudi bona bo tsejwa e le bohahlaudi ba setso.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Bahahlaudi ba ka etela mehaho ya bohlokwa e sa tshwaneng ya naha e itseng kapa ba ka kgetha feela hore ba lebise tlhokomelo sebekeng se le seng feela.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Bo-radikoloni, ha ba bona mosebetsi ona, ba ile ba batla hore ho matlafatswe.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Mabotho a matlafatsang maemo a leng pele a ne a akarelletsa mabotho a pele le a boraro a New Hamphire ya banna ba 200, tlaase ha Makoronele John Stark le James Reed (hamorao bobedi ba bona ile ya ba balaodi)
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Banna ba Stark ba ile ba nka maemo haufi le terata e leng ka qetellong ya leboya moo e leng boemo ba Bo-radikoloni.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Ha maqhubu a kokobetseng a bula sekgeo ho Noka ya Mystic ka leboya-botjhabela ba hlwahlwa, ba ekeditse terata ka lebota le lekgutswanyane la majwe ho ya ka leboya le fellang moeding wa metsi lebopong le lenyenyane.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley kapa Stark o behile thupa e ka bang bophahamo ba maoto a 100 (30 m) ka pele ha terata mme a fana ka taelo ya hore ho se ke ha eba le ya thunyang ho fihlela ho fetile ba tlwaetseng ho feta.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Polane ya Amerika e ne e itshehile ka ho qalwa ha ditlhaselo tse hokahantsweng ho tloha mahlakoreng a mararo a fapaneng.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Molaodi John Cadwalder o ne a tla qala tlhaselo e fapa-fapaneng kgahlanong le mabotho a Brithani ka Bordentown, e le ho thiba ho matlafatsa le ha e le hofe.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Molaodi James Ewing o ne a nka masole a 700 ho tshela noka ya Trenton Ferry, a hape borokho bo leng Assunpink Creek mme a thibele masole le ha e le afe a dira hore a balehe.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Lebotho la ho hlasela le ka sehloohong la banna ba 2,400 le ne le tshela noka di-mile tse robong ka leboya la Trenton, mme le arohane e be dihlopha tse pedi, se seng ka tlaase ha Greene mme se seng ka tlaase ka Sullivan,e le hore ba qale tlhaselo ya pele letsatsi le tjhaba.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Ka phetoho ya ho matha ho tloha ho kotara ho ya ho halofo ya mile, lebelo le fetoha le seng bohlokwa hakaalo mme mamello e fetoha se hlokahalang haholo.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Ke nnete hore motho ya mathang halofo ya mile a le sehlopheng se pele, o tshwanetse ho ba le boholo ba lebelo bo lekaneng, empa mamello e lokela ho hlaolelwa dikotsing kaofela.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Ho matha mabaleng a bulehileng ka mariha, ho kopantswe le boikwetliso ba mmele ba karolo e hodimo ya mmele, ke yona tsela e ntle ya ho itokisetsa nako ya ho matha.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Mekgwa e hantle ya phepo e nepahetseng ka boyona e ke ke ya baka ho bapala hwa boemo bo phahameng, empa e ka ama ho phela ha baatlelete ba batjha ka kakaretso ka tsela e bonahalang.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Ho boloka tekanyo ya matla e boemong bo botle, ho itlwaetsa mekgwa e sebetsang ya ho nwa metsi a lekaneng, le ho utlwisisa dikarolo tse fapaneng tsa mekgwa e tlatsetsang mmele ho ka thusa baatlelete ho ntlafatsa ho bapala ha bona le ho nyolosa ho thabela ha bona papadi eo.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Ho matha ho leng bohareng ke papadi eo ha e bapiswa e sa bitseng tjhelete e ngata; le ha ho le jwalo, ho na le mehopolo e mengata e fosahetseng mabapi le dikarolowana tse mmalwa tsa thepa e hlokahalang ho nka karolo.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Dihlahiswa di ka rekwa ho ya kamoo di hlokahalang kateng, empa tse ngata di na le tshusumetso e nyenyane kapa e seyong ha di sebediswa.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Baatlelete ba ka ikutlwa ba rata sehlahiswa le hoja se sa fane ka melemo ya nnete.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Athomo e ka nkuwa jwaloka e ngwe ya dikarolwana tse hahang tsa motheo tsa dintho tsohle.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Ke boleng bo rarahaneng haholo bo akarelletsang, ho latela sesebediswa se nolofaditsweng sa Bohr, khubu e bohareng e potolohuwang ke dielektrone, ho tshwanang ka tsela e itseng le dipolanete di potoloha letsatsi - see Figure 1.1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Khubu e na le dikarolwana tse pedi - di-neutron le diprothone.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Diprothone di na le bokgoni bo phahameng ba motlakase ha di-neutron di se na motlakase. Dielektrone di na le bokgoni bo tlaase ba motlakase.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Ho Hlola mohlaseduwa, o lokela pele o hlahlobe sebaka mme o netefatse polokeho ya hao.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: O lokela ho hlokomela boemo ba mohlaseduwa ha o ntse o mo atamela le matshwao a lemosang kotsi a hlahellang.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Haeba o lemala o ntse o leka ho thusa, e ka ba feela hore o mpefatsa dintho le ho feta.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Phuphutso e fumane hore ho tepella maikutlo, tshabo le ho baka tlokotsi ke mokena-dipakeng wa kamano pakeng tsa bohloko le ho holofala ho batho ba utlwang bohloko karolong e tlaase ya mokokotlo.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Ke diphello tsa ho baka tlokotsi, eseng ho tepella maikutlo kapa tshabo ho neng ho baka mananeo a PA a etswang kgafetsa a lokiseleditsweng ka beke le beke.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Batho ba nkang karolo boikwetlisong ba kamehla ba hloka tshehetso e kgolo mabapi le mohopolo o fosahetseng wa bohloko ho kgona ho bona diphapang tsa lehlaba le sa feleng le ho ho se ikutlwe hamonate ka ho itshisinya mmele ho tlwaelehileng.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Pono, kapa bokgoni ba ho bona bo itshetlehile ka ditho tsa kutlo tsa tsamaiso ya pono kapa mahlo.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Ho na le dibopeho tse fapaneng tsa mahlo, tse fapaneng ka ho rarahana ho itshetlehile ka se hlokahalang ho mofuta wa ntho e phelang.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Dibopeho tse fapaneng di na le bokgoni bo fapaneng, di ameha ka bolele bo fapaneng bo tlohang ntlheng e nngwe ho ya ho e nngwe mme di na le ditekanyo tse fapaneng tsa bohale, hape di hloka ditshebetso tse fapa-fapaneng hore di utlwisise hantle se kenang ho tsona le dinomoro tse fapa-fapaneng hore di sebetse hantle haholo.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Baahi ke pokello ya dintho tse phelang tsa mefuta e itseng tse nang le sebaka se kgethehileng.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Ha batho ka bomong kaofela bao e leng baahi ba tshwana mabapi le tshobotsi tse bonahalang tse bakilweng ke tikoloho ba tsejwa e le ba phelang e le mofuta o le nngwe.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Ha batho ka bomong ba bontsha mefuta e mmalwa e sa tshwaneng ya tshobotsi e itseng ba phela e le mefuta e fapa-fapaneng.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Mabotho a bohlwa a tsamaya le ho haha matlo ka mekgahlelo e fapaneng ka ho tshwanang.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Mokgahlelong wa hloma-o-hlomole, mabotho a bohlwa a tsamaya bosiu mme a eme hore a kampe motshehare.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Bohlwa bo qala mokgahlelo wa hloma-o-hlomole ha dijo tse leng teng di fokotsehile. Ka nako ya mokgahlelo ona, bohlwa bo etsa dihlaha tsa nakwana tse fetolwang letsatsi le letsatsi.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Ho tswa letsholo hona kapa kapa ho tsamaya ka ho hloma-o-hlomole ho nka matsatsi a ka bang 17.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Sele ke eng? Lentswe sele le hlaha lentsweng la Selatine e leng “cella” e bolelang “phaposi e nyenyane” mme le ile la qapuwa pele ke setsebi sa mochine o hodisang ponahalo ya dintho a shebile sebopeho sa cork.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Sele ke motheo wa dintho tsohle tse phelang, mme dintho tsohle tse phelang di sele e le nngwe kapa tse ngata.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Disele ke tsa motheo kapa tse bohlokwa thutong ya bophelo, hoo hangata di bitswang “dintho tse hahang bophelo”
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Tsamaiso ya Methapo e boloka homeostasis ka ho romela melaetsa ya methapo mmeleng ohle ho tsweletsa pele phallo ya madi e tsamayang hantle e sa sitisehe.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Melaetsa ena ya methapo e ka romelwa ka potlako mmeleng ohle e le se thusang mmele o bolokohe tshokelong le ha e le efe e ka hlahellang.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Difefo tse matla di otla sebaka se senyenyane ha ho bapiswa le difefo tse mabifi, empa di ka senya ntho e nngwe le e nngwe e leng tseleng ya tsona.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Difefo tse matla di fothola difate, di tlosa mapolanka a leng mehahong, mme di lahlele dikoloi hodimo. Diphesente tse pedi tsa difefo tse matla tse mabifi haholo di nka nako e fetang dihora tse tharo.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Difefo tsena tse mabifi di na le moya o fokang o ka bang 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Batho ba ntse ba etsa le ho sebedisa dilense ho hodisa ponahalo ya dintho dilemo tse dikete-kete.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Le ha ho le jwalo, dibonela-hole tsa nnete tsa ho qala di entswe Europe qetellong ya lekgolo la dilemo la bo16.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Dibonela-hole tsena di ne di sebedisa motswako wa dlense tse pedi ho etsa dintho tse hole di bonahale di le haufi mme di le kgolo.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Meharo le boithati ho tla dula ho le teng mme ke boemo ba ho sebedisana ba hore moo ba bangata ba ruwang molemo teng ho tla dula ho na le ho hongata ho ka ruiwang ka nako e kgutshwanyane ka ho tshwara ka boithati.
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Re tshepa hore, bongata ba batho bo tla bona hore ho kgetho e ntle haholo ke ho sebedisana le ba bang.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Batho ba bangata ba lora ka nako eo ba tla kgonang ho ya naleding e nngwe mme ba bone le mafatshe a mang, batho ba bang ba ipotsa hore ho na le eng kantle, ba bang ba dumela hore batho ba dipolanete tse ding kapa mefuta e meng ya dintho tse phelang di dula polanenteng e nngwe.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Empa, haeba sena sea etsahala mohlomong se ka se etsahale nako e telele. Dinaledi di hasane hohle hoo ho ka bang le di-mile tse ditrilione pakeng tsa dinaledi tseo e leng “baahisani”.
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Mohlomong ka tsatsi le leng, ditlohololwana tsa hao di tla be di eme hodimo ha lefatshe la dibopuwa tsa lefatshe le leng di ipotsa ka baholo-holo ba tsona.
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Diphhofolo di entswe ka disele tse ngata. Di ja dintho mme di di sille ka hare. Diphoofolo tse ngata di kgona ho sisinyeha.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Ke diphoofolo feela tse nang le boko (le hoja e se diphoofolo tsohle tse jwalo, jellyfish, ka mohlala, ha e na boko).
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Diphoofolo di fumanwa hohle lefatsheng. Di epa fatshe, di sesa mawatleng, mme di fofa sepakapakeng.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Sele ke sebopeho se senyenyane se sebetsang sa (dintho) kapa dibopuwa tse phelang.
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Sele e tswa lentsweng la Selatine e leng cella e bolelang phaposi e nyenyane.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Ha o sheba dintho tse phelang ka tlaase ha motjhine o hodisang ponahalo ya dintho, o tla bona hore o entswe ka disekwere tse nyenyane kapa dibolo.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, setsebi sa baeloji se tswang Engelane, o bone disekwere tse nyenyane tsa cork ka motjhine o hodisang ponahalo ya dintho.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Di ne di shebala jwaloka diphaposi. E ne e le motho wa ho qala wa ho hlahloba disele tse shweleng.
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Dielemente le metswako di ka tloha boemong bo bong ho ya ho bo bong mme di se ke tsa fetoha.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Naetrojene jwaloka kgase e na le dika tse tshwanang le naetrojene ya mokedikedi. Boemo ba mokedikedi bo teteaane empa dimolek’hule di ntse di tshwana.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Metsi ke mohlala o mong. Motswako wa metsi o entswe ka diathomo tse pedi tsa haedrojene le athomo e le nngwe ya oksijene.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: E na le sebopeho se tshwanang sa dimolek’hule e ka ba kgase, mokedikedi kapa ho hwama.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Le hoja boema ba yona ba mmele bo ka fetoha, boemo ba dik’hemik’hale bo sa ntse bo tshwana.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Nako ke ntho e re pota-potileng, mme e ama ntho e nngwe le e nngwe eo re e etsang, le ha ho le jwalo e boima ho e utlwisisa.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Diithuti tsa bodumedi, filosofi le saense di ithutile ka nako dilemo tse dikete.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Re bona nako e le diketsahalo tse latellanang tse fetang di tloha nakong e tlang ho ya nakong ya hona jwale ho ya nakong e fetileng.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Nako hape ke tsela eo re bapisang nako e nkilweng (botelele) ke diketsahalo
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: O ka tshwaya ho tsamaya ha nako ka ho hlahloba ho pheta-phetwa ha ketsahalo e potolohang. Ketsahalo e potolohang ke ntho e etsahalang nako le nako kgafetsa.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Dik’homputha kajeno di entswe hore di fetole ditshwantsho le dividiyo.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Dipopae tse rarahaneng di ka etswa dik’homputhareng, mme mofuta ona wa dipopae o ntse o sebediswa ka ho ata haholo televisheneng le dibaesekopong.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Mmino hangata o rekotuwa ho sebediswa dik’homputha tse rarahaneng ho tsamaisa le ho kopantsha medumo.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Nako e telele lekgolong la dilemo la leshome le metso e robong le la mashome a mabedi, hone ho dumelwa hore baahi ba New Zealand e ne e le batho ba Maori, bao ba neng ba tsoma dinonyana tse kgolo tse bitswang di-moa.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Kgopolo ena e ne e re batho ba Maori ba falletse ho tloha Polynesia ka Dikepe tse Kgolo mme ba nkela batho ba Mamoriori New Zealand, ba qala setjhaba sa temo.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Le ha ho le jwalo, bopaki bo bontsha hore batho ba Bamoriori e ne e le sehlopha sa karolo e kgolo ya Maori se falletseng ho tloha New Zealand ho ya Dihlekehlekeng tsa Chatham, ba etsa setso sa bona se arohileng, sa kgotso.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Ho ne ho na le morabe o mong dihlekehlekeng tsa Chatham bana e ne e le Bamaori ba falletseng ho tloha New Zealand.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Ba ne ba ipitsa Bamoriori ho ne ho na le ho lwana ho itseng mme qetellong, Bamoriori ba ile ba timetswa bohle
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Batho ba neng ba nka karolo mashome a mmalwa a dilemo ba re thusitse ho ananela bokgone le dithahasello tsa rona re be re hlahlobisisa ka ho hlaka ka maemo a thata e bile le ho hloleha.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Ka he re mametsi batho ba bua ka ditaba tsa bona, tsa lelapa le tsa mokgatlo, re fumane boitsebiso ba bohlokwa ba nako e feteleng le ba botho ba batho ba itseng ba eneng e le tshusumetso e ntle kapa e mpe setsong sa mokgatlo
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Le ha ho utloisisa histori ya motho ho sa bue hore o utloisisa setso, bonnyane ho thusa batho ho ba le mohopolo wa hore ba ne ba le hokae historing ya mokgatlo.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Ha ba hlahlobisisa ho atleha le ho tseba ho hloleha, batho ka bang le batho bohle ba nkang karolo ba tla fumana ka ho teba melao, thomo, le matla a susumetsang a mokgatlo.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Tabeng ena, ho hopola makgetlo a feteleng a ho itshwara ha rakhoebo le katleho e bileng teng ho thusitse batho ho bula diphetoho tse ntjha le mehato e metjha ya kereke ya sebakeng seo.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Ditaba tse jwalo tsa katleho di fokoditse ho tshaba phetoho, di be di etsa hore batho ba be le mohopolo o mo ntle wa phetoho nakong e tlang.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Ditema tse kopanang tsa menahano ke bothekeniki ba ditharollo tse kopanyang maikutlo kapa mapatlelo a ho fumana tharollo.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Tsepamiso e kgolo ya mohopolo ona e bile hodima lebelo, kelello le ho nepa, hape le tsebahatso ya dinnete, ho sebedisa botjha bothekeniki bo se ntse bo le teng, ho bokeletsa tlhahisoleseding.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Ntlha ya bohlokwa ka ho fetisisa ya mohopolo ona ke: hore ho na le karabo e le nngwe feela e nepahetseng. O nahana ka dikarabo tse pedi feela, ho nepahala le ho fosahala.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Mofuta ona wa ho nahana o amana le mekgwatshebetso e itseng ya saense le ya maemo.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Batho ba nang le mofuta ona wa monahano ba nahana ka tsela e utlwahalang, ba kgona ho matlafatsa kgopolo ya ditema dikelellong tsa bona, ho rarolla mathata le ho sebetsana le diteko tsa saense.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Batho ke dibopuwa tse nang le bokgoni bo fetang ba tse ding ba ho bala dikellelo tsa ba bang.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Sena se bolela hore re kgona ho noha ka katleho seo batho ba bang ba se lemohang, ba ikemiseditseng sona, ba se dumelang, ba se tsebang kapa ho se labalabela.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Har’a bokgoni bona, ho utlwisisa boikemisetso ba batho ba bang ho bohlokwa haholo. Ho re dumella ho rarolla ditlhaloso tse sa hlakang tse ka hlahellang tsa diketso tsa mmele.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Ka mohlala, ha o ne o ka bona motho a thuba fensetere ya koloi, mohlomong o ne o ka nahana o leka ho utswa koloi ya motho eo a sa mo tsebeng.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: O ne a tla hloka ho ahlolwa ka tsela e fapaneng haeba a ne a lahlile dinotlolo tsa koloi ya hae mme e le koloi ya hae eo a lekang ho e qheketsa.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: MRI e thehilwe ketsahalong ya saense e bitswang nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), e ileng ya fumanwa ka bo1930 ke Felix Bloch (ya neng a sebetsa Univesithi ya Stanford) hammoho le Edward Purcell (ya tswang Univesithi ya Harvard).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Ho resonance ena, matla a kgohedi le maqhubu a seya-le-moya ho baka diathomo ho ntsha matshwao a seya-le-moya a manyenyane.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Ka selemo sa 1970, Raymond Damadian, ngaka le rasaense o a etsang diphuphutso, u fumane motheo wa ho sebedisa ho nahana ha magnetic resonance imaging jwalo ka sesebediswa sa ho fumana bolwetse.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Dilemo tse nne hamorao ho ile ha fanwa ka tumello, eo e neng e le tumello ya ho qala lefatsheng e ntshitsweng lefapheng la MRI.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Ka 1977, Dr. Damadian o qetetse ho aha mochene wa MRI wa ho-scanner “mmele ohle” wa hoqala, oo a o biditseng “Indomitable”.
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Ho buisana ho sa etsahaleng ka nako e le nngwe ho kgothalletsa nako ya ho nahanisisa hammoho le ho arabela ba bang.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Ho dumella diithuti di be le bokgoni ba ho sebetsa ka nako ya tsona le ho laola lebelo la boitsebiso ba ditaelo.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Ho ekelletsa moo, ho na le dithibelo tsa nako tse mmalwa ka monyetla wa dihora tsa ho sebetsa tse feto-fetohang. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Tshebediso ya Inthanete le ya World Wide Web di kgona ho etsa hore diithuti di fihlelle boitsebiso ka dinako tsohle.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Diithuti di ka fa barupedi dipotso ka nako e nngwe le e nngwe ya letsatsi mme ba letele dikarabo tsa kapele ka ho itekanetseng, ho e na le hore ba emele kopano ya ho bonana ka sebele e latelang.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Tsela ya sejwale-jwale ya ho bala e fana ka tokoloho dinthong tse nang dithibelo. Ha ho na tsela e le nngwe e ntle feela ya ho ithuta.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Ha e le hantle, ha ho na ntho e le eng eo motho a lokelang ho ithuta yona. Ho ithuta ho etsahala pakeng tsa moithuti le tsebo e fannwang.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Seo re se boneng ha jwale ka dilo tsohle tsa ho iketsetsa le ho fana ka boitsebiso, mananeo a thelevishene a thehilweng ho ithuteng a hlahisa ntlha ena.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Bongata ba rona re iphumana re shebelletse mananeo a thelevishene tse re bolelang ka tsamaiso kapa ntho e etsahalang eo re ke keng ra nka karolo ho yona kapa re sebedise tsebo eo.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Re ke ke ra lokisa koloi, re hahe sediba kamorao ha jarete ya rona, re nke leeto le yang Peru ho hlahloba masupi a boholo-holo, kapa re lokise tlo ya moahisani wa rona.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Ka lebaka la ho hokahana ha dik’hebole tsa fibre tse tsamayang tlaase ha lewatle tsa Europe le sathelaete ya ho hokahanya, Greenland e hokahane hantle ka baahi ba 93% ba nang le inthanete.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Hotele kapa moamohedi wa hao (haeba o dula ntlung ya baeti kapa lehaeng la motho) ho ka etsahala hore ho tla ba le wifi kapa k’homputha e hokahantsweng inthaneteng, mme dibaka tsohle di na le mabenkele a inthanete kapa dibaka tse ding tsa wifi ya setjhaba.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Jwalo kaha ho se ho boletswe ka hodimo, le hoja lentswe "Eskimo" le amohelehile ka hare ho United States, le nkuwa le sa amoheleha ho batho bao e seng ba U.S. batho ba Arctic, haholo ba Canada
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Leha o ka utlwa lentswe leo le sebediswa ke matswallwa a Greenland, tshebediso ya lona e tlameha ho qojwa ke baditjhaba.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Matswallwa ebile ele bahai ba Greenland ba ipitsa Inuit naheng ya canada le Kalaaleq(ka bongata ke Kalaaalit), Greenlander, naheng ya Greenland.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Tlolo ya molao ha mmoho le ho tshwara melata hampe, ke ntho e sa tsejweng Greenland mme ha hona dibaka tse kotsi.
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Boemo ba lehodimo bo batang e batlile e le bona feela kotsi eo batho ba ka itokisetsang yona eo ba tla lebanang le yona.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Ha o etela Greenland ka dinako tsa selemo tse batang (le ho nahanela hore haeba o ya ka leboya, ho tla bata haholo), ho bohlokwa hore o tshware diaparo tse futhumetseng ka ho lekaneng.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Matsatsi a matelele haholo ka lehlabula a ka baka mathata a ho robala nako e lekaneng le mathata a amahaneng le tsa bophelo.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Ka lehlabula, hlokomela hape le menwang ya Nordic. Le hoja di sa fetisetse malwetsi, empa di ka tena.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Le hoja moruo wa Sans Fransisco o amahantswe le ho ba sebaka e etellang pele lefatsheng ya ho hohela bahahlaudi, moruo wa yona o fapa-fapane.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Dikarolo tse kgolo tsa ho fana ka mesebetsi ke ditshebetso tsa ditsebi, tsa mmuso, tsa ditjhelete, tsa ho rekisa le tsa bohahlaudi.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Ho bontshiwa ha yona mminong, dibaesekopong, dibukeng le ditsong tse ratwang ho thusitse ho etsa toropo le diemahale tsa yona di tsejwe lefatsheng ka bophara.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco e potolohilwe ke mehaho e meholo ya bahahlaudi tse nang le dihotele tse ngata, dibaka tsa ho jela, le mehaho ya dikopano e leng boemong bo hodimo.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco e boetse ke e nngwe ya dibaka tse ntle haholo naheng ho fumana dijo tse ding tsa Asia: tsa Korea, tsa Thailand, tsa India le tsa Japane.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Ho etela Walt Disney World ho emela leeto le leholo la ho ya sebakeng se halalelang malapeng a mangata a Amerika.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Ho eta ho “tlwaelehileng” ho akarelletsa ho fofa o ye Boema-fofane ba Ditjhaba ba Orlando, ho palama bese e yang hoteleng e Disney, ho qeta nako e ka bang beke o sa tswe sebakeng sa Disney, le ho kgutlela hae.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Ho na le dintho tse ngata tseo o ka kgethang ho tsona, empa sena e dula e le seo batho ba se bolelang ha ba bua ka ho “ya Disney World”.
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Ditekete tse ngata tse rekiswang ka inthanete ka diwebsaete tsa ho fantisa jwaloka eBay kapa Craigslist di sebediswa ka karolo jwaloka ditekete tsa ho ya dirapeng tse ngata ka matsatsi a mangata.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Le hoja sena e le mosebetsi o tlwaelehileng haholo, o hanetswa ke Disney: ditekete ha di fetisetswe ho ba bang.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Ho etsa kampo leha e le hofe ka tlase ho mosiko wa Grand Canyon ho hloka phemiti ya dithoteng tseo tsa bohahlaodi.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Diphemiti di lekanyeditswe ho sirelletsa canyon, ebile di fumaneha ka letsatsi la pele la kgwedi, dikgwedi tse nne pele ho kgwedi e qalang.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Jwale, phemiti ya naha thote e qalang ka Motsheanong e tla fumaneha ka Pherekg.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Sebaka sa dibakeng tse tummeng, jwaloka Bright Angel Campground e bapileng le Phantom Ranch, hangata dia tlala ho tloha letsatsing la pele leo dikopo tsa ho behelwa sebaka di bulelwang.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Diphemiti dia fokola ka palo bakeng sa dikopo tsa batho ba itlelang feela ka leano la ya fihlileng pele, o sebeletswa pele.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Ho kena Afrika e Borwa ka koloi ke tsela e makatsang ya ho bona botle bohle ba sebaka hammoho le ho fihla dibakeng tse kantle ho ditsela e tlwaelehileng ya bahahlaudi.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Sena se ka etsahala koloing e tlwaelehileng haeba o hlophisa ka hloko empa 4x4 ke yona eo ho kgothalletswang hore o e sebedise haholo hape o ka kgona ho fihla dibakeng tse ngata ka 4x4 e nang le mabili a phahameng feela.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Hopola ha o ntse o rera hore le hoja Afrika e Borwa e se na merusu ha se dinaha tsohle tsa baahisani tse leng jwalo.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Ditlhokahalo tsa visa le ditshenyehelo di fapana ho ya ka dinaha mme ho amuwa ke naha eo o tswang ho yona.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Naha e ngwe le e ngwe e na le melao e fapaneng e hlokang dintho tse itseng tsa boemo ba tshohanyetso tse hlokahalang hore di be teng ka hare ho koloi.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Phororo ya Victoria ke toropo e leng karolong e bophirimela ba Zimbabwe, ho feta moedi ho tloha Livingstone, Zambia, le haufi le Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Toropo e haufi haholo le diphororo, hape ke sebaka se ratwang ke bahahlaudi haholo, empa sebaka sena e ratwang ke bahahlaudi e fa ka bobedi batho ba ratang dintho tse kotsi le batho ba shebang sebaka menyetla e mengata ya hore ba dule nako e telele.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Ka nako ya pula (November ho ya ho March), tekanyo ya metsi e tla ba hodimo mme Diphororo di tla ba le matla haholo.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: O netefatswa hore o tla koloba ha o feta borokgo kapa o tsamaya ditselaneng tse haufi le Diphororo.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Lehlakoreng le leng, ke ka lebaka la hore tekanyo ya metsi e hodimo haholo hoo ho sheba ha hao Diphororo ho tla sireha—ke metsi ohle.
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Lebitla la Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 e ka ba le tummeng haholo la mabitla a leng Phuleng, sebaka seo Howard Carter 1922 a fumaneng lebitla le sa senngwang la sebaka sa ho pata sa boreneng sa morena e mo nyenyane.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Ha le bapiswa le mabitla a mang a mangata a boreneng, le ha ho le jwalo, lebitla la Tutankhamun ha ho bohlokwa hakaalo ho le etela, jwalokaha le le lenyenyane haholo hape le na le mekgabiso e lekanyeditsweng.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Le ha e le mang ya nang le thahasello ya ho bona bopaki ba tsenyo e bakilweng setopong se omisitsweng ka nako ya ho lekwa ho se ntsha ka hare ha lekase o tla swaba jwalokaha ho bonahala hlooho le mahetla feela.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Maruo a makatsang a lebitla ha sa leyo ho lona, empa a tlositswe a yiswa Musiamo ya Egepeta e leng Cairo.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Ho ka ba molemo hore baeti ba nang le nako e lekanyeditsweng ba sebedise nako ya bona sebakeng se seng.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, e 12 km borwa-bophirimela ba Siem Reap. Tempele ena e ka hodimo ha leralla e hahuwe qetellong ya lekgolo la bo-9 la dilemo, nakong ya puso ya Morena Yasovarman.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Tikoloho e sa hlakang ya tempele le ho shebahala ha letsha la Tonle Sap ho etsa ho palamela leralleng ho tshwanelehe.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Ho etela sebaka ho ka kopangwa ha bonolo fela le leeto la sekepe ho ya letsheng.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Tsela ya ho Feta ya Angkor ya hlokeha hore o kene tempeleng kahoo o seke wa lebala ho tla le phasepoto ya hao ha o ya Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Jerusalema ke motse-moholo wa Iseraele, le ha dinaha tse ngata tse ding le Ditjhaba tse Kopaneng di sa e nke jwalo ka motse-moholo wa Iseraele.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Toropo ya kgale Dithabeng tsa Judea e na le histori e thahasellisang e nkileng dikete tsa dilemo.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Toropo ya halalela madumeding a mararo a dumelang ho Modimo a le mong - Bojuda, Bokreste le Boislamo, mme ke setsi sa bomoya, bodumedi, le setso.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Ka lebaka la ho ba bohlokwa ha toropo bodumeding, mme haholo dibaka tse ngata tsa sebaka sa Old City, Jerusalema ke engwe ya dibaka tse ka sehloohong tseo bahahlaudi ba di etelang Iseraele.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Jerusalema e na le ditsi tse ngata tsa histori, tsa dintho tsa kgale le tsa setso, hammoho le dbaka tsa ho reka tse phetheselang le tse tletseng batho, di-café, le dibaka tsa ho jela.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ecuador e hloka hore baahi ba Cuba ba fumane lengolo la memo pele ba kena Ecuador ka boema-fofane ba ditjhaba kapa meedi ya ho amohela batho.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Lengolo lena le lokela ho etswa le be molaong ke Lefapha la Ditaba tsa Kantle ho Naha tsa Ecuado, mme le tsamaisane le ditlhokeho tse itseng.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Ditlhokeho tsena di entswe hore di fane ka phallo e hlophisitsweng ya ho falla pakeng tsa dinaha tse pedi.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Baahi ba Cuba ba nang le green card ya US ba lokela ho etela Diofisi tsa Boemedi tsa Ecuador hore ba lokellwe tlhokehong ena.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Phasepoto ya hao e lokela ho ba e molaong bonnyane dikgwedi tse 6 hodimo ha dikgwedi tsa leeto la hao. Tekete ya ho ya le ho kgutla ya hlokahala ho pakela botelele ba nako eo o tla e dulang.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Maeto ha a bitse haholo bakeng sa dihlopha tse kgolo, kahoo haeba o le mong kapa o na le motswalle a le mong, leka ho kopana le batho ba bang mme le etse sehlopha sa batho ba e ka bang ba nne kapa ba tsheletseng bakeng sa theko e molemonyana ya motho ka bomong.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Le ha ho le jwalo, sena ha sea lokela ho ho tshwenya, hobane hangata bahahlaudi ba bangata ba tsamaiswa hohle hore ho tlatswe dikoloi.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Ho bonahala hantle-ntle e le tsela ya ho qhekanyetsa batho hore ba tshepe hore ba tshwanetse ho lefa ho eketsehileng.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Ntho e phahametseng ya karolo e ka leboya ya Machu Picchu ke thaba ena e telele, hangata e le se hlahellang ka morao ditshwantshong tsa dithako.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Ho bonahala ho tshosa hanyenyane ho tloha tlaase, hape ke sebaka se moepa le seo ho leng boima ho nyolohela ho sona, empa batho ba batlang ba itekanetse ba ka kgona ho ho etsa ka metsotso e 45.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Mehato ya majwe e behilwe boholong ba tsela, mme dikarolong tsa meepa dithapo tsa tshepe di fana ka tshehetso ya ho beha matsoho.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Kahoo, lebella hore o tla fellwa ke moya, mme o itlhokomele dikarolong tse theohelang, haholo ha ho le metsi, jwalokaha ho ka ba kotsi ka potlako.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Ho na le lehaha le lenyenyane haufi le tlhoro eo ho tshwanetsweng ho fetwe ho lona, le fatshe haholo mme le moqotetsane.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Ho bona dibaka le diphoofolo tsa naha tsa Galapagos ho etsuwa hamolemo ka sekepe, jwalokaha Charles Darwin a ile a ho etsa ka 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Ke dikepe tsa bahahlaudi tse fetang 60 tse tsamayang metsing a Galapagos - di fapana ka boholo ho tloha ho 8 ho ya ho 100 ya bapalami.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Batho ba bangata ba beheletsa sebaka sa bona ho sa ntse ho na le nako (kaha dikepe di a tlala nakong ya selemo se phetheselang).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Tiiseha hore moemedi eo o beheletsang sebaka ho yena ke setsebi sa Galapagos ya nang le tsebo ya dikepe tse fapa-fapaneng.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Sena se tla netefatsa hore dithahasello tse tseng tsa hao le/kapa ditshitiso di tshwantshwa le sekepe se di tshwanetseng haholo.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Pele batho ba Spain ba fihla ka lekgolo la bo16 la dilemo, Chile e ka leboya e ne e le tlaase ha puso ya Inca ha matswallwa a Araucania (Mapuche) a ntse a dula Chile e bohareng le e ka borwa.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mamapuche e ne e le se seng sa dihlopha sa ho tswallwa moo tse ikemetseng tsa ho qetela tsa Amerika, tseo di neng di sa kena ka ho felletseng molaong wa ho bua Spanishe kamorao ha ho ikemela ha Chile.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Le hoja Chile e patlaladitse ho Ikemela ka 1810 (hare ha dintwa tsa Napoleon tse siileng Spain e se na mmuso o moholo dilemo tse mmalwa), tlholo e matla kgahlanong le batho ba Spain ha ya ka ya etsahala ho fihlela ka 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Dominican Republic( Spanish:República Dominicana) ke nahana ya Caribean e nkang halofo ya lehlakore le ka borwa la sehlekehleke sa Hisaniola, eo se e kopanetseng le Haiti.
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti
