text: Ntle ho mahlabathe a mawatle a masweu le mesiko ya dithaba, naha ena ke lehae la kgale la toropo ya Yuropa ka hare ho America, eo e leng karolo ya Santo Domingo ha jwale.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Sehlekehleke sena se ile sa ba sa pele sa ho hapuwa ke Taínos le Caribes. Macaribe e ne e le batho ba puo ya Arawakan ba fihlileng nakong ya 10,000 BCE.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Dilemong tse mmalwa kamora ho fihla hwa bafuputsi ba Yuropa, batho ba Tainos ba ne ba ile ba fokotswa haholo ke bahale ba Sepanishe.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Ho ya ka Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) pakeng tsa 1492 le 1498 batho ba Taíno ba ka bang 100,000 ba ile ba bolawa ke bahale ba Spanish.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Sebaka sena se ne se hahilwe jwaloka phaseje bakeng sa setjhaba sa bodumedi sa lekgolo la bo-17 la dilemo, eo Templo de San Diego e leng ona fela mohaho o setseng.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Jwale e sebetsa jwaloka setsi se bohareng, mme e dula e na le dintho tse ngata tse etsahalang, motshehare le bosiu.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Ho na le dibaka tsa ho jela tse mmalwa tse potolohileng serapa, mme thapama le mantsiboya ho na le dikhonsarete tse bang teng hangata tenteng e bohareng.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Diforanta tse pedi tse arohaneng ka disenthimitara tse 69 feela ke lehae la pale ya kgale ya lerato.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Ka tjhelete e nyane feela bana ba ko ho qoqela pale.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Sehlekehleke sa Bowen ke leeto la letsatsi le ratwang kapa leeto la ho intsha la mafelo-beke le akarelletsang kayaking, ho hlwa dithaba, mabenkele, dibaka tsa ho jela, le ho hong.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Motse ona wa nnete o sebakeng se leng Howe Sound ho tloha fela Vancouver, mme o fihlelleha ha bonolo ka ditekese tsa metsing tse lokiseditsweng tse tlohang Sehlekehlekeng sa Granville se leng toropong ya Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Bakeng sa bao ba thabelang mesebetsi ya kantle, leeto la ho ya tseleng ya Sea to Sky le bohlokwa.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (leeto dihora tse 1.5 ka koloi ho tloha Vancouver) e bitsa haholo empa e tsejwa hohle ka lebaka la Diolimpiki tsa Mariha tsa 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Ka mariha, thabela ho thellisa lehlweng ho hong ho hotle haholo ho leng America Leboa, mme ka lehlabula leka ho palama dithaba ka baesekele ha nnete.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Ditumello di tshwanetse hore di fumanwe pele ho nako. O tshwanetse ho ba le tumello hore o dule bosiu bohle Sirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena ke yona feela seteishene sa bahlokomedi ba serapa se fanang ka sebaka sa ho dula le dijo tse tjhesang hodimo ha dikampo. La Leona, San Pedrillo le Los Patos e fana ka dikampo feela tse se nang tshebeletso ya dijo.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Ho ka etsahala hore o fumane ditumello tsa serapa ka ho tobileng Seteisheneng sa Bahlokomedi se leng Puerto Jiménez, empa ha ba amohele dikarete tse ho reka ka sekoloto.
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Tshebeletso ya Serapa (MINAE) ha e fane ka ditumello tsa serapa ho feta kgwedi e le nngwe pele ho letsatsi la ho eta.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol e fana ka tshebeletso ya ho etsa tokisetso ya theko ya US$30, kapa $10 ho kena letsatsi le le leng; dintlha di leqhepeng la Corcovado.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Dihlekehleke tsa Cook ke naha ya sehlekehleke e ikamahantseng ka boithatelo le New Zealand, tse leng Polynesia, bohareng ba Lewatle le Leholo la Pacific le ka Borwa.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Ke sehlopha sa dihlekehleke sa dihlekehleke tse 15 tse hasaneng dimilione tse 2.2 km2 tsa lewatle.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Ka nako ya sebaka e tswhanang le ya Hawaii, dihlekehleke ka nako e nngwe di nkuwa jwaloka “Hawaii ka tlaase”.
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Le hoja e le nyenyane, e hopotsa baeti ba hodileng ka Hawaii pele e emiswa jwaloka mmuso e se na dihotele tse kgolo tsa bahahlaudi le dikaho tse ding.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Dihlekehleke tsa Cook ha di na le ha e le dife ditoropo empa e entswe ka dihlekehleke tse 15 tse fapaneng. Tse ka sehloohong ke Rarotonga le Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Kajeno dinaha tse tswetseng pele, ho fana ka dibaka tse majabajaba tsa ho robala le tsa dijo tsa hoseng ho se ho entswe e ka re ke bonono.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Boemong bo hodimo, di-B&B ka ho hlakileng di hlodisana ka dintho tse pedi tse ka sehlohoong: marobalo le dijo tsa hoseng.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Ka tsela eo, dibakeng tsa maemo a hodimo motho a ka fumana marobalo a majabajaba haholo, mohlomong lesela la ho kwahela bethe le entsweng ka letsoho kapa bethe ya boholo-holo.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Dijo tsa hoseng di ka akarelletsa dijo tse fumanehang ka sehla se itseng tsa sebaka seo kapa dijo tse kgethehileng tsa mongantlo.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Hlophiso e ka ba moaho wa kgale wa histori o nang le thepa ya boholo-holo, dirapa tse kgabisitsweng le letamo la ho sesa.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Ho kena koloing ya hao mme o nke leeto le letelele ho a kgahlisa le hoja e se ntho e majabajaba.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Ho fapana le dikoloi tse kgolo, ho ka etsahala hore o se o tlwaetse ho kganna koloi ya hao mme o tseba meedi ya yona.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Ho beha tente sebakeng sa motho kapa toropong ya boholo le ha e le bofe ho ka ho biletsa mahlo ho sa hlokahale.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Ka bokguntshwanyane, ho sebedisa koloi ya hao ke tsela e ntle haholo ya ho nka leeto empa ha se hangata e le tsela ya ho “kampa”.
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Ho kampa koloing ho ka etsahala haeba o na le vene, SUV, Sedan kapa Station Wagon se se nang le ditulo tse kgonang ho robala.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Dihotele tse ding di na le lefa ho tloha ho diterene tsa mashala le dikepe tse majabajaba; pele ho Ntwa ya Bobedi ya Lefatshe, lekgolong la bo-19 kapa mathwasong a lekgolo la bo-20 la dilemo.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Dihotele tsena e ne e le sebaka seo batho ba ruileng le ba tummeng ba nako eo ba neng ba dula ho tsona, mme hangata di ne di na le dijo tse monate mme bosiu ho ketekwa.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Diaparo tsa kgale, ho hlokeha ha dintho tse thabisang, le tsela e thahasellesang ya ho hola e sa le karolo ya botho ba bona.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Le hoja ka tlwaelo di na le beng ba tsona, ka nako tse ding di amohela baetapele ba dinaha le bahlomphehi ba bang.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Motsamai ya nang le tjhelete e ngata a ka nna a nahana ho potoloha lefatshe ka sefofane ho arohantsweng ka ho dula dihoteleng tsena tse ngata.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Tshebeletso ya ho abelana ka kamohelo ya baeti ke mokgatlo o kopantshang batsamai le batho ba sebakeng ditoropong tseo ba tla di etelang.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Ho kenela tsamaiso e jwalo hangata ho hloka fela hore o tlatse fomo ya inthanete, le hoja ditsamaiso tse ding di fana kapa di hloka ho netefatswa ho eketsehileng.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Lethathamo la baamohedi ba fumanehang le ba teng e ka ba le hatisitsweng le/kapa le inthaneteng, ka dinako tse ding ka ditshupiso le ditlhatlhobo tsa batsamai ba bang.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Ho dula nakwana dintlung tsa batho ho qadilwe ka January 2004 kamorao ha hore mongodi wa mananeo a di k’homputha Casey Fenton a fumane sefofane se sa bitseng ho ya Iceland empa a sena sebaka sa ho dula.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: O rometse di-email ho diithuti tse leng univesithing ya sebakeng mme a fumana batho ba bangata haholo ba batlang ho mo fa bodulo bo sa lefellweng.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Dihostele ka ho kgetheha ke tsa batho ba batjha – moeti ya tlwaelehileng o dilemong tsa moshome a mabedi – empa hangata o ka fumana le batsamai ba baholo ba le teng moo.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Malapa a nang le bana ke ka sewelo a bang teng, empa dihostele tse ding dia ba dumella ka dikamoreng tsa bona tsa boinotshing.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Toropo ya Beijing e leng Chaena e tla ba toropo eo ho tshwarelwang Dipapadi tsa Mariha tsa Diolimpiki tsa 2022, ho tla e etsang toropo ya ho qala eo ho tshwaretsweng ka bobedi Diolimpiki tsa lehlabula le tsa mariha.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing e tla tshwara mokete wa ho bula le ho kwala le dipapadi tse bapallwang leqhweng tsa ka hare.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Dipapadi tse ding tse ding tsa ho thellisa leqhweng di tla ba sebakeng sa ho thellisa leqhweng sa Taizicheng e ileng Zhangjiakou, ho e ka bang 220 km (di-mile tse 140) ho tloha Beijing.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Bongata ba ditempele bo na le mokete wa Selemo o qalang ho tloha ka bofelong ba November ho fihlela bohareng ba May, ho fapanang ho ya ka khalendara ya selemo ya tempele.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Bongata ba mekete ya tempele bo ketekwa e le karolo ya sehopotso sa tempele kapa letsatsi la ho tswalwa la modingwana ya busang kapa ketsahalo le ha e le efe e nngwe e kgolo e amahanngwang le tempele.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Mekete ya tempele ya Kerala e thahasellisa haholo ho e bona, ka mokolokolo wa ka mehla wa ditlou tse kgabisitsweng, mmino wa diletsa tsa tempele le mekete e meng.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: World’s Fair (e tlwaelehileng ka ho bitswa World Exposition, kapa Expo) ke mokete o moholo wa mafatshe ya tsa boqapi le saense.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Dinaha tse nkang karolo di bontsha dintho tsa boqapi le tsa thuto dibakeng tsa lefatshe lohle ho bonahatsa mathata a lefatshe kapa setso le histori ya naha.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: International Horticultural Expositions ke diketsahalo tse kgethehileng tse bontshang dipontsho tsa dipalesa, dirapa le ntho le ha e le efe e tsamaisanang le dimela.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Le hoja ha ho bolelwa di ka etsahala ka selemo (hafeela di le dibakeng tse fapa-fapaneng), ka sebele ha ho jwalo.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Diketsahalo tsena ka ho tlwaelehileng di nka nako e tlohang ho dikgwedi tse tharo ho ya ho tse tsheletseng, mme di tshwarelwa dibakeng tse seng nyenyane ho feta di-hectare tse 50.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Ho na le mefuta e mengata ya difilimi e neng e sebediswa dilemong tse fetileng. Filimi e tlwaelehileng ya 35 mm (negative ya 36 e pheta-phetilweng ka 24 mm) ke yona e tummeng haholo.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Ka ho tlwaelehileng e ka ekelletswa habonolo haholo ha e fela, mme e fana ka ponahalo e lekanyetswang ho se le teng ho DSLR.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Mefuta e meng ya dik’hamera tsa difilimi tsa mofuta-o bohareng e sebedisa mofuta wa 6 e pheta-phetilweng ka 6 cm, ka ho nepahetseng haholo negative ya 56 e pheta-phetilweng ka 56 mm.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Sena se fana ka ponahalo e phethilweng hoo e ka bang ha nne ha negative ya 35 mm (3136 mm2 ha e bapiswa 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Diphoofolo tsa naha ke dinepe tseo ho leng boima haholo ho di nka ke motho ya nkang difoto, mme ho hloka ho kopanngwa ha lehlohonolo, mamello, ho ba le phihlelo le disebediswa tse hantle.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Ho nka dinepe tsa diphoofolo tsa naha ke ntho e kgelwang fatshe, empa jwalo ka ho nka dinepe tse tlwaelehileng, setshwantsho se ka buwa ho hongata.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Ho nka dinepe tsa diphoofolo tsa naha hangata ho hloka lense e telele, le hoja dintho tse tshwanang le dinyonyane tse ngata kapa dibopuwa tse nyenyane di hloka dilense tse ding.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Ho boima ho fumana diphoofolo tse ngata tsa mafatsheng a mang, mme dirapa ka dinako tse ding di na le melao e mabapi le ho nka dinepe ka morero wa ho etsa kgwebo ka tsona.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Diphoofolo tsa naha di ka ba le dihlong kapa leqhoko. Tikoloho e ka ba e batang, e tjhesang kapa ho seng jwalo e hlaha.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Lefatshe le na le dipuo tse fapaneng tse ka hodimo ho 5,000, tse akarelletsang tse fetang tse mashome a mabedi tse buiwang ke batho ba 50 wa dimilione kapa ho feta.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Mantswe a ngotsweng hangata ho bonolo ho a utlwisisa ho feta mantswe a bolelwang, hape. Sena ke nnete haholo ka diaterese, tseo ho leng boima ho di bitsa hantle.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Ditjhaba tse ngata tse felletseng di kgona ho bua Senyesemane hantle, hape le ho tse ding tse ngata o ka lebella tsebo e lekanyeditsweng - haholo ho batho bao e sa leng batjha.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Nahana, ha o ka kgona, motho wa Mancunia, wa Bostonia, wa Jamaica le wa Sydneysider ba ja dinare sebakeng sa ho jela se leng Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Ba iqoqela ba le bang ka ditaba tsa ditoropong tsa habo bona, tse bolelwang ka dipuo tsa bona tse fapaneng le tsela ya ho buwa ya habo bona.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Ho reka dijo di suphamaketeng ka ho tlwaelehileng ke tsela e sa bitseng tjhelete e ngata ya ho iphepa. Ntle le menyetla ya ho pheha, dikgetho le ha ho le jwalo di lekanyetswa ho dijo tse se ntseng di lokiselleditswe.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Ka ho atang disuphamakete di fumana karolo e fapaneng haholo ya dijo tse lokiselleditsweng. Tse ding di fana ka onto ya microwave kapa ditsela tse ding tsa ho futhumatsa dijo.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Dinaheng tse ding kapa mefuteng ya mabenkele ho na le bonnyane sebaka se le seng sa ho jela se leng moo, hangata e seng molaong ka ditheko tse tlaase.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Etsa mme o tshware dikopi tsa polisi ya hao le dintlha tsa ho ikopanya tsa inshorense ya hao.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Di lokela ho bontsha aterese ya email ya inshorense le dinomoro tsa mohala tsa dinaha tse ding bakeng sa keletso/ditumello le ho etsa dikopo.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Eba le kopi e nngwe ka hare ho thoto ya hao le inthaneteng (ithomelle email ka kenyelletso, kapa e bolokilweng ho “cloud”).
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Haeba o nka leeto ka laptop kapa tablet, boloka kopi polokong ya yona kapa ho disc (e fihlellehang ntle le inthanete).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Hape fana ka dikopi tsa polisi/dintlha tsa ho ikopanya ho batho bao o nkang leeto le bona le maloko kapa metswalle e leng hae e ikemiseditseng ho thusa.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Di moose (tse tsejwang jwale ka di elk) ha di rate bo ba leqhoko, empa di tla itshireletsa ha di bona tshokelo.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Ha batho ba sa bone di moose jwalo ka tse ka bang le kotsi, ba ka atamela haholo mme ba ipeha kotsing.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: E nwa dino tse tahang ka tekatekano. Bojwala bo ama batho bohle ka ditsela tse fapaneng, mme ho tseba moedi wa hao ho bohlokwa.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Dintho tse ka amang bophelo ha nako etse e tsamaya ka lebaka la ho nwa haholo di akareletsa tshenyo ya sebete le bofofu le lefu. Kotsi e ka bang teng e eketseha haholo ha motho a nwa bojwala bo seng molaong.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Jwala bo thata bo ka eba le ditshila tse fapaneng tse kotsi tse akareletsang methanol, e ka bakang bofofu kapa lefu le ha ho nwewa e nyenyane.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Dikgalase tsa mahlo di ka bitsa tjhelete e nyenyane naheng e nngwe, haholo-holo dinaheng tse lefang tjhelete e nyenyane moo ditshenyehelo tsa ho sebetsa di leng tlaase.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Nahanela ho fumana tlhahlobo ya mahlo hae, haholo-holo haeba inshorense e lefa ditshenyehelo, le ho tla le lengolo la ngaka la meriana hore le bolokwe sebakeng se seng.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Diforeime tsa boleng bo hodimo tsa mabitso dibakeng tse jwalo ka tsena di ka ba le mathata a mabedi, tse ding e ka ba tse e seng tsa nnete, mme tsa nnete tse rometsweng naheng eo di ka bitsa tjhelete e ngata ho feta hae.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Kofi ke e nngwe ya dihlahiswa tsa lefatshe e rekiswang haholo, mme o ka kgona ho fumana mefuta e mengata sebakeng sa heno.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Le ha ho le jwalo, ho na le ditsela tse ngata tse kgethehileng tsa ho nwa kofi ho polotoha lefatshe tse lokelang ho lekwa.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Canyoning (kapa: canyoneering) e mabapi le ho ya botlaaseng ba kgohlo, e ka bang e omile kapa e tletse metsi.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Canyoning e akarelletsa dikarolo tsa ho sesa, ho palama le ho tlola--empa ho hlokahala kwetliso e nyenyane kapa ho itekanela mmeleng hore o qadise (ha ho bapiswa le ho palama majwe a maholo, scuba diving, kapa alpine skiing, ka mohlala).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Ho hahlaula naha ke mosebetsi wa kantle o akarelletsang ho tsamaya ditikolohong tsa tlhaho, hangata ditseleng tsa ho hahlaula naha.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Ho hahlaula naha ho ka qetwang ka letsatsi ho akarelletsa bohole bo ka tlaase ho mile ho ya ho bohole bo botelele bo ka finyellwang ka letsatsi le le leng.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Bakeng sa ho hahlaula naha ho ka qetwang ka letsatsi tseleng e bonolo ho hlokeha ditokisetso tse nyenyane, mme motho le ha e le ofe ya itekanetseng hantle a ka di thabela.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Malapa a nang le bana ba banyenyane a ka hloka ditokisetso tse ngata, empa ho bonolo ho hlola ka ntle letsatsi lohle esita le ha ho e na le masea le bana ba eso qale sekolo.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Dinaheng tsohle, ho na le ho e ka bang mekgatlo ya bohahlaudi e tsamaiswang e 200. Bongata ba yona bo sebetsa bo ikemetse.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Mohlahlami wa Global Running Tours e leng Go Running Tours e hokahanya bafani ba ditshebeletso tsa batho ba bonang dibaka ba ntse ba matha, dihontinenteng tse nne.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: E na le metso ho Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona le Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, ile ya salwa morao ke Running Tours Prague e thehilweng Prague le tse ding.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Ho na le dintho tse ngata tseo o tshwanetseng ho nahana ka tsona pele o nka leeto ho ya sebakeng se itseng.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Ha o nka leeto, lebella hore dintho di ke ke tsa tshwana le “hae”. Mekgwa, melao, dijo, sephethephethe, bodulo, ditekanyetso, puo jwalo jwalo ho tla fapana ka tsela e itseng le moo o dulang teng.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Sena se lokela ho ba ntho eo o dulang o e hopotse, ho qoba ho soetseha kapa mohlomong ho hloya ditsela tsa sebakeng tsa ho etsa dintho.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Bahlophisi ba maeto ke kgale ba le teng ho tloha ka lekgolo la bo19 la dilemo. Mohlophisi wa leeto ka ho tlwaelehileng ke kgetho e ntle ya leeto le fetellang ka nqane ho leeto la motsamai la nako e fetileng la tlhaho, setso, puo kapa dinaha tse lefang tjhelete e nyenyane.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Le hoja bahlophisi ba bangata ba ikemiseditse hore ba thuse ka ho etsa ditokisetso tsa ho beheletsa sebaka tsa kamehla, bahlophisi ba bangata ba sebetsa ka ho kgetheha ka mefuta e itseng ya ho nka leeto, le meralo ya tjhelete e fapaneng kapa dibaka tseo ho etelwang ho tsona.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Ho ka ba molemo hore o sebedise mohlophisi eo kgafetsa a etsang ditokisetso tsa ho beheletsa sebaka sa maeto a tshwanang le a hao.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Sheba hore ke maeto a feng ao mohlophisi a a kgothalletsang, e ka ba websaeteng kapa fensetereng ya lebenkele.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Haeba o batla ho bona lefatse ka, ha ho hlokeha, tsela ya ho phela e sa bitseng tjhelete e ngata kapa teko, ho na le ditsela tsa ho etsa seo.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Ha e le hantle, di kena dikarolong tse pedi: E ka nna ya eba o sebetsa o ntse o nka leeto kapa o leka ho lekanyetsa ditshenyehelo tsa hao. Sehlooho sena se buwa ka karolo ya bobedi.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Bakeng sa bao ba ikemiseditseng ho lahlehelwa ke mabotho-botho, nako le ponelo-pele ya hore o sututse ditshenyehelo di fihle ho noto, sheba leeto la moralo wa tjhelete e nyenyane.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Keletso e nahanela hore batsamai ha ba utswe, ha ba kene sebakeng ntle le tumello, ha ba nke karolo dimmarakeng tse seng molaong, ha ba kope, kapa ho hanyapetsa batho ba bang hore ho rue bona.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Sebaka sa ho hlola diphasepotso tsa bafalli ka ho tlwaelehileng ke sebaka sa ho qala seo o yang ho sona ha o theoha sefofaneng, sekepeng kapa sepalanngwang se seng.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Ditereneng tse ding tse tshelang moedi ho hlola ho etswa ditereneng tse tsamayang mme o lokela ho ba le ID e leng molaong ha o palama diterene tseo.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Ditereneng tseo ho robalwang ho tsona, phasepote e ka nkuwa ke mohlahlobi wa ditekete tsa terene hore o se wa sitiswa ha o se o robetse.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Ho ngodisa ke tlhokeho e eketsehileng ya ho fumana visa. Dinaheng tse ding, o lokela ho ngodisa ho ba teng ha hao le aterese ya moo o dulang teng le balaodi ba sebaka.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Sena se ka hloka ho tlatsa fomo le mapolesa a sebakeng kapa ho etela diofisi tsa ho falla dinaheng tse ding.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Dinaheng tse ngata tse nang le molao o jwalo, dihotele tsa sebakeng ke tsona tse tla ngodisang (etsa bonnete ba hore wa botsa).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Maemong a mang, ke bao feela ba dulang kantle ho dintlo tsa bahahlaudi ba tshwanetseng hore ba ngodise. Le ha ho le jwalo, sena se etsa hore molao o be thata haholo, kahoo batlisisa esale pele.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Tsebo ya meralo ya e lebisitse tlhokomelo ho qapeng le ho haheng mehaho. Tsebo ya meralo ke sebaka seo hangata bahahlaudi ba ratang ho se etela.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Mehaho e mengata e metle haholo ho e shebella ho sheba sebaka o le mohahong o mo telele kapa fenstereng e behilweng ka bohlale e ka ba ntho e ntle ho e bona.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Tsebo ya meralo ya kaho e kopana haholo le mafapha a mang meralo ya ditoropo, boenjiniere ba ditsela, boqapi bo kgabisang, ho kgabisa ka hare ho ntlu le ho kgabisa dirapa.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Ka tsela eo metse ya batho ba tswalletsweng Amerika e leng hole ka teng, o ke ke wa fumana ho hongata ho etsahalang bosiu ntle le hore o ye Albuquerque kapa Santa Fe.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Le ha ho le jwalo, ho e ka bang di-casino tsohle tse boletsweng ka hodimo di fana ka dino mme tse mmalwa tsa tsona di na le boithabiso bo tsejwang (ka sehloohong tse kgolo ho tsona tse haufi haholo le Albuquerque le Santa Fe).
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Hlokomela: dibare tsa ditoropo tse nyenyane mona ha se hangata e le dibaka tse ntle bakeng sa moeti ya tswang kantle ya batlang ho phomola.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Lebaka le leng ke hore, New Mexico e ka leboya e na le mathata a mangata ka lebaka la batho ba kganna ba tahilwe, mme bongata ba bakganni ba tahilweng ba tletse haholo dibareng tse nyenyane haufi le ditoropo.
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Ditshwantsho tse maboteng tse sa batleheng le mengolo e meng e tsejwa jwalo ka graffiti.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Le hoja e se ntho e makatsang kajeno, batho ba bangata hangata ba e amahanya le batjha ba senyang mehaho ya setjhaba le ya batho ba sebedisa pente e nyanyatsowang.
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Le ha ho le jwalo, kajeno ho na le baqapi ba tsejwang ba graffiti, diketsahalo tsa graffiti le mabota a “molaong”. Boqapi ba graffiti tabeng ena hangata bo tshwana le mesebetsi ya boqapi ho feta ditheke tse sa dumellwang.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Ho lahlela boomerang ke bokgoni bo ratwang boo bahahlaudi ba bangata ba batlang ho ba le bona.
text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Haeba o batla ho ithuta ho lahlela boomerang e tla kgutlang hape letsohong la hao, netefatsa hore o na le boomerang e tshwanelehang bakeng sa ho kgutla.
text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Di-boomerang tse ngata tse fumanehang Australia ha ele hantle ke tse sa kgutleng. Ho molemo hore ba qalang ho ithuta ba se ke ba lahlela moo ho nang le moya
text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Sejo sa Hangi se phehelwa mokoting o tjhesang fatshe.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Mokoti e ka nna ya ba o futhumatswa ka majwe a tjhesang a tswang mollong, kapa dibakeng tse ding motjheso o tswang mpeng ya lefatshe o etsa dibaka tse fatshe di tjhese ka tlhaho.
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Hangi hangata e sebediswa ho pheha dinara e tlwaelehileng ya mofuta o besitsweng.
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Dibaka tse mmalwa Rotorua di fana ka hangi e entsweng ka motjheso o tswang mpeng ya lefatshe, ha hangi e nngwe e ka fumanwa Christchurch, Wellington le dibakeng tse ding.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail e na le dihlopha tse pedi tsa diterene tsa batsamai Cape Town le haufi le yona. MetroPlus (hape e bitswang Sehlopha sa Pele) le Metro (e bitswang Sehlopha sa Boraro).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus e mabothobotho haholo mme ha ya tlala empa e bitsa tjhelete e ngata haholwanyane, le hoja e sa bitse ho feta ditekete tsa metro tse tlwaelehileng Europe.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Terene e nngwe le e nngwe e na le ka bobedi materoko a MetroPlus le a Metro; materoko a MetroPlus a dula a le qetellong ya terene haufi haholo le Cape Town.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Ho rwalla ba bang morwalo - O se ke wa tlohela mekotla ya hao o sa e bone, haholo-holo ha o tshela meedi ya dinaha tse ding.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: O ka iphumana o sebediswa jwaloka motshwari wa dithethefatsi ntle le tsebo ya hao, se ka ho kenyang mathateng a maholo.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Sena se akarelletsa ho ema moleng, kaha dintja tse fofonelang dithethefatsi di ka sebediswa nako efe kapa efe ntle le ho o tsebisa.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Dinaha tse ding di na le ditsela tsa ho otla tse sehloho haholo le bakeng sa ba qalang ho tlola molao; tsena di ka akarelletsa dikahlolo tsa tjhankane tsa dilemo tse fetang 10 kapa lefu.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Mekotla e siilweng fela ke phofu ya boshodu mme di ka bitsa tlhokomelo ya balaodi ba hlokomelang ditshokelo tsa dibomo.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Hae, ka lebaka la ho pepesetseha kgafetsa ho dikokwana-hloko tsa sebakeng, ho na le menyetla ya hore o se ntse o kgona ho itshireletsa ho tsona.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Empa dikarolong tse ding tsa lefatshe, moo diphoofolo tseo e leng dibaktheria di leng tse ntjha ho wena, ho na le menyetla e mengata ya hore o tla ba le mathata.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Hape, moo ho futhumetseng dibaktheria di hola ka potlako haholo mme di kgona ho phela sebaka ka ntle ha mmele.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Ke ka lebaka leo ho nang le mahlomola Delhi Belly, Pharaoh’s Curse, Montezuma’s Revenge, le metswalle ya bona e mengata.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Jwalo ka mathata a amanang le ho hema dibakeng tse batang, mathata a ka maleng dibakeng tse tjhesang a tlwaelehile haholo mme maemong a mangata a tena haholo empa ha kotsi hakaalo.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Haeba o nka leeto naheng e ntseng e hola moruong ka lekgetlo la pele – kapa karolong e ntjha ya lefatshe – o se ke wa nyenyefatsa ho makatswa ke setso ho ka bang teng.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Batsamai ba bangata ba tsitsitseng, ba nang le bokgoni ba aparelwa ke botjha ba ho nka leeto dinaheng tse ntseng di hola moruong, moo ditokiso tse nyenyane tse ngata tsa setso di ka eketsehang ka potlako.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Haholo-holo matsatsing a hao a qalang, sebedisa tjhelete e ngata dihoteleng tsa mofuta wa Bophirimela le tsa boemo bo hodimo, dijo, le ditshebeletso ho ho thusa hore o tlwaele sebaka.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: O se ke wa robala materaseng kapa seponcheng fatshe dibakeng tseo o sa tsebeng diphoofolo tsa sebaka.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Haeba o tlo kampa, e tla le bethe e nyenyane e phuthwang kapa mealo a fanyehwang hore o be hole le dinoha, diphepeng le dintho tse jwalo.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Etsa hore lehae la hao le nkge kofi e matla hoseng le tee ya chamomile e kgathollang bosiu.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Ha o nka matsatsi a phomolo o le hae, o na le nako ya ho itlhokomela le ho nka metsotso e mmalwa e eketsehileng ho etsa ho hong ho kgethehileng.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Ha o ikutlwa o na le tjantjello, nka monyetla wa ho etsa jusi kapa ho kopantsha ditholwana hore e be seno:
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: mohlomong o tla fumana seno se bonolo seo o ka se etsang bakeng sa dijo tsa hoseng ha o kgutlela tseleng ya hao ya ho phela ya ka mehla.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Ha o dula toropong e na leng setso se fapa-fapaneng sa ho nwa, e ya dibareng kapa dintlung tsa jwala tse leng sebakeng sa heno tse o sa yeng ho tsona kgafetsa.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Ho bao ba sa tlwaelang puo ya tsa kalafo, mantswe ho fetelana le ho tshwaetsana a na le ditlhalose tse arohileng.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Bolwetsi bo fetelanang ke bo bakwang ke dintho tse kang, dikokwana-hloko, dibaktheria, fungus kapa dipharasaete.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Bolwetsi bo tshwaetsanang ke bolwetsi bo fetelanang habonolo ka ho ba haufi le motho ya nang le bolwetsi.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Mebuso e mengata e hloka hore baeti ba kenang, kapa baahi ba tsamayang, dinaha tsa bona ba entwe bakeng sa malwetsi a fapa-fapaneng.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Ditlhoko tsena hangata di itshetlehile ka hore ke dinaha tse feng tseo mopalami a di etetseng kapa a ikemiseditseng ho di etela.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Ntho e nngwe eo Charlotte e Carolina Leboya e ipabolang ka yona ke hore e na le dintho tse ngata tsa boemo bo hodimo tseo malapa a ka kgethang ho tsona.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Batho ba tsoang dibakeng tse ding ba re e mosa ho malapa mme ke lona lebaka la motheo la ho fallela moo, mme hangata baeti ba fumana ho le bonolo ho thabela toropo le bana.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Dilemong tse mashome a mabedi tse fetileng, dikgetho tse tshwanetseng bana tse Uptown Charlotte di eketsehile haholo.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Ditekisi ha di sebediswe hangata ke malapa ka Charlotte, le hoja di ka sebediswa maemong a itseng.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Ho na le tefo e eketsehileng ha ho na le bapalami ba fetang 2, kahoo kgetho ena e ka bitsa haholo ho sa hlokahale.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antarctica ke sebaka se batang ka ho fetisisa Lefatsheng, mme e saballetse mane Ntlheng e ka Borwa ya Lefatshe.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Maeto a bahahlaudi a tura haholo, a hloka motho ya shahlileng, mme a ba nakong ya lehlabula feela ho tloha kgweding ya Pudungwana ho ya ho Hlakola, mme hangata a fella Hlwahlweng, Dihlekehlekeng le Lewatleng la Ross.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Ho na le basebetsi ba dikete di se kae ba dulang mona hlabula dikampong tse mashome a mane a metso e robedi tseo boholo ba tsona di leng dibakeng tseo; ke palo e nyane e salang moo mariha.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Naha ya Antarctica ke lesabasaba le siilweng kgerehlwa le kwahetsweng ke lehlwa le bongata ba dikhilomithara tse 2-3.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Ka dinako tse ding bahahlaudi ba etsang mesebetsi e itseng ba leba kahara naha ka sefofane, ba hlwa dithaba kapa ba leba Ntlheng, moo ho nang le kampo e kgolo.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: South Pole Traverse (kapa Highway) ke tselana ya 1600 km e tlohang Seteisheneng sa McMurdo Leoatleng la Ross ho fihlela Pole.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: E tletse lehlwa ka ho petsoha ho tlatsitsweng mme e tshwauwe ka difolaga.E ka tsamauwa feela ke diterkere tse kgethehileng, tse hulang di selei tsa mafura le disebediswa.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Tsena ha di potlake hakaalo kahoo tsela e lokela ho nka sebaka se setelele ho potoloha Dithaba tsa Transantarctic ho fihla sehlabeng.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Ntho e bakang dikotsi haholo ka mariha ke mebila e thellang, litselana tsa maoto (moo ho tsamaelwang thoko), hape haholo-holo litepisi.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Ka ho lekanyetsa, o hloka dieta tse nang le direthe tse tshwanelehang. Dieta tsa lehlabula ka ho tlwaelehileng di thella haholo leqhweng kapa lehlweng, le dibutsi tsa mariha dia tshwaneleha.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Paterone e lokela ho ba e tebileng ka ho lekaneng, 5 mm (1/5 inch) kapa ho feta, mme lesela e be bonolo ho lekananetseng ha ho bata.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Dibutsi tse ding di na le dikonopo mme ho na le disebediswa tsa dikonopo tse eketswang bakeng sa maemo a thellang, tse loketseng dieta tse ngata le dibutsi, bakeng sa direthe le kapa direthe le bohato.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Direthe li lokela ho ba tlase le bophara. Lehlabathe, lehlohlojane kapa letswai (calcium chloride) hangata le hasana ditseleng kapa litselelaneng ho ntlafatsa tshubuhlellano.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Diqubuhadi ha se ntho e sa tlwaelehang, methipoloho e theosang e ka tshwara feela lehlwa le seng lekae, mme bongata bo setseng bo tla theoha jwaloka diqubuhadi.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Bothata ke hore lehlwa lea namathela, kahoo le hloka ho susumetswa hore le theohele tlaase, mme ho theoha ha lehlwa le itseng ho ka susumetsa le setseng.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Ka dinako tse ding ketsahalo e susumetsang ho tloha qalong ke letsatsi le futhumatsang lehlwa, ka dinako tse ding ke lehlwa le leng le nang, ka dinako tse ding ke diketsahalo tse ding tsa tlhaho, hangata ke motho.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Sefefo se matla ke kgatello ya moya o bilikang, o hulang moya o potolohileng ka hare le hodimo.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Se baka meya e hodimo (hangata 100-200 ya dimaele/ka hora) mme e ka phahamisa dintho tse boima hodimo, e di rwala ha sefefo se matla se ntse se foka.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Se qala joaloka difanele tse theohang ho tswa marung a sefefo, mme se fetoha “difefo tse matla” ha se fihla fatshe.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Bafani ba VPN (virtual private network) ya botho ke mokgwa o motle wa ho fumana tsela ka bobedi ho thibelo ya dipolotiki le IP-geofiltering ya kgwebo.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Ba ka hodimo ho bafani ba di web ka mabaka a mmalwa. Ke tsela ya sephethephethe sohle sa Inthanete, eseng feela http.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Ka tlwaelo di fana ka marang-rang a lebelo le ditshebeletso tsa boleng bo molemonyana. Di entswe ka matshwao a lekunutu kahoo ho boima ho hlwela ho tsona.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Dikhamphani tsa metjha ya ditaba ka tlwaelo di bua leshano ka morero wa sena, di bolela hore ke ho “thibela boshodu”.
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Ha e le hantle, dikhoutu tsa sebaka ha di na phello ho hang ho etseng kopi ho seng molaong, kopi e entsweng hanyane-hanyane ya diski e tla bapala hantle feela sesebedisweng le ha e le sefe moo ya nnete e ka bapalang teng.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Morero wa nnete ke ho fa dikhampani tseo matla dimmarakeng tsa tsona, ke taba feela ya ho etsa tjhelete.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Ka lebaka la hore mehala e tsamaiswa ka Inthanete, ha ho hlokahale hore o sebedise founu ya khamphani e leng sebakeng seo o dulang ho sona kapa moo o nkang leeto teng.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Hape ha ho na tlhokahalo ya hore o fumane nomoro ya sebakeng ho tswa motseng oo o dulang ho ona, o ka fumana kgokahano ya sathelaete ya inthanete hlatheng ya Chicken, Alaska mme o kgethe nomoro e bolelang hore o Arizona e chesang.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Hangata, o lokela ho reka nomoro ya lefatshe lohle e le nngwe e dumellang mehala ya PSTN hore e ho letsetse. Moo nomoro e tswang teng ho etsa phethoho e kgolo ho batho ba ho letsetsang.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Mananeo a ho fetolela mongolo o ngolwang hona jwale – mananeo a nang le bokgoni ba ho fetolela ka ho iketsahallang dikgeo tsohle tsa mongolo ho tloha puong e nngwe ho ya ho e nngwe.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Mananeo a mang a leng karolong ena a kgona le ho fetolela mengolo ho dipuo disele e le matshwao kapa disebediswa tse ding tse teng lefatsheng ha motho a supisa smartphone ho disebediswa tseo.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Dikgeo tsa ho fetolela di ntlafaditswe ka ho makatsang, mme jwale hangata di fana ka diphetolelo tse ka bang tse nepahatseng (mme ka sewelo e le tse sa utlwahaleng) empa ho sa ntse ho lokela ho hlokomelwa, kaha ho ka etsahala di etsa diphoso.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: E nngwe ya mananeo a hlahelletseng karolong ena ke Google Translate, e dumellang phetholelo ho sa kenwa ho inthanete kamorao ha ho kopitsa boitsebiso ba puo eo o e batlang.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Ho sebedisa mananeo a ho tsamaya o batla tsela a GPS ka smartphone sa hao e ka ba tsela e bonolo le e loketseng ya ho tsamaya o batla tsela ha o le kantle ho naha ya heno.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Ho ka boloka tjhelete ho feta ho reka dimmapa tse ntjha tsa GPS, kapa sebediswa se ikemetseng sa GPS kapa ho e hira ho tswa ho khamphani ya ho hira koloi.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Haeba o se na kgokahano ya datha founung ya hao kapa ha e sa fihlellehe, ho sebetsa ha yona ho ka lekanyetswa kapa ya se ke ya sebetsa.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Lebenkele le leng le leng le leng sekgutlong le tletse ka letoto le ferekanyang la dikarete tsa mohala o lefellwang tse ka sebediswang ho tswa ho difounu tse lefellwang kapa dithelefono tse tlwaelehileng.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Le hoja dikarete tse ngata di loketse ho letsetsa kae kapa kae, tse ding si etseditswe ho fana ka ditheko tse molemo tsa ho letsa mohala dihlopheng tse itseng tsa dinaha.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Phihlello ho ditshebeletso tsena hangata ke ka nomoro ya thelefono e sa lefellweng e ka letsetswang ho tswa ho mehala e mengata ntle le tefo.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Melao e mabapi le ho nka dinepe kamehla e sebetsa hape le ho nkeng video, mohlomong ho feta moo.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Haeba ho nka senepe sa ntho e itseng ho sa dumellwa, o se ke wa naha le ho e nka video.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Haeba u sebedisa drone, hlahloba hantle esale pele hore na o dumellwa ho filima eng le hore ke diphemiti kapa dilaesense dife hape tse tla hlokeha.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Ho fofisa drone haufi le boema-fofane hodimo ha letshwele ho batlile ho dula e le kgopolo e mpe, le hoja ho dumelletswe molaong sebakeng sa heno.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Matsatsing a na ke ka sewelo ho beheletswang leeto la sefofane le khamphani ya sefofane ka ho tobileng ntle le ho etsa dipatlisiso le ho bapisa ditheko.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Ka dinako tse ding sefofane se tshwanang se ka eba le ditheko tse fapaneng haholo tsa dikhamphani tse fapa-fapaneng mme hape ho na le molemo ho bapisa diphello tsa ho etsa patlisiso hape o shebe websaete ya difofane ka bo yona pele o etsa tokisetso.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Le hoja o ke ke wa hloka visa bakeng sa maeto a makgutshwanyane ho etela dinaha tse itseng jwaloka mohahlaudi kapa ka lebaka la kgwebo, ho ya moo jwaloka seithuti sa naha e nngwe ka tlwaelo hloka hore o dule sebaka se setelele ho fapana le ha o ile ho hahlaula.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: ka ho tlwaelehileng, ho dula naheng e nngwe nako e telele ho tla hloka hore o fumane visa ho sa ntse ho ena le nako.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Di visa tsa diithuti ka ho tlwaelehielng di na le ditlhokahalo tse fapa-fapaneng hammoho le ditshebetso tsa ho ngodisa ho tloha ho mohahlaudi ya tlwaelehileng kapa divisa tsa kgwebo.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Dinaheng tse ngata, o tla hloka lengolo la ho amohelwa ho tswa sebakeng seo o labalabelang ho ithuta ho sona, le bopaki ba tjhelete ba hore o tla tla kgona ho itjara bonyane selemo sa ho qala sa ho ithuta.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Hlola le sebaka, hammoho le lefapha la ditaba tsa bojaki la naha eo o batlang ho ithuta ho yona hore o fumane ditlhokahalo tse hlakileng.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Ntle le ha o le moemedi wa dinaha, ho sebetsa mose ho mawatle ka kakaretso ho bolela hore o tla lokela ho ngodisetsa lekgetho la basebedtsi naheng eo o dulang ho yona.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Lekgetho la basebetsi le hlophisitswe ka tsela e fapaneng dinaheng tse fapaneng, mme ditheko tsa lekgetho le mefuta di fapana haholo ho ya ka dinaha.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Dinaheng tse ding tse kopaneng, jwaloka United States le Canada, lekgetho la basebetsi le lefiswa boemong bo kopaneng le ba sebakeng, kahoo ditheko le mefuta e ka fapana ho ya ka dibaka.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Le hoja ho hlola bojaki hangata ho seyo kapa e le tlwaelo naheng ya heno, moo ho hlolwang batho ba kenang ho ka ba boima.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Etsa bonnete ba hore o tseba seo o ka tlang le sona kapa o ke keng wa kgona ho tla le sona le ho bonahatsa ntho le ha e le efe e fetang ditekanyo tsa molao.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Tsela e bonolo haholo ya ho qadisa kgwebong ya ho ngola ka ho nka maeto ke ho ntlafatsa bokgoni ba hao websaeteng e thehilweng ya blog ya ho nka leeto.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Ka moraho ha hore o tlwaele ho fometa le ho edita inthaneteng hamorao o ka nna wa iqapela websaete ya hao.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Ho ba moithaopi ha o nka leeto ke tsela e ntle ya ho etsa phapang empa ha se feela bakeng sa ho fana.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Ho phela le ho ithaopela naheng engwe ke tsela entle ya ho tseba setso se fapaneng, ho kopana le batho ba batjha, ho ithuta ka wena, ho fumana pono engwe ha mmoho le ho fumana bokgoni bo botjha.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: E ka boela ya ba tsela e ntle ya ho sebedisa tjhelete hamolemo ho dumela ho dula nako e teletsana sebakeng se seng ka ha mesebetsi e mengata ya boithaopo e fana ka kamore le bodulo mme e mmalwa e lefa moputso o monyenyane.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Maviking a sebedisitse ditsela tsa metsi tsa Russia ho fihla Lewatleng le Letsho le Lewatleng la Caspian.Dikarolo tsa ditsela tsena di ntse di ka sebediswa. Hlahloba kgonahalo ya tlhokahalo ya di tumello tse kgethehileng, tseo ho ka bang thata ho di fumana.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Lewatle le Lesweu–Baltic Canal e hokahanya Lewatle la Arctic le Lewatle la Baltic, ka Letsha la Onega, Lesha la Ladoga le Saint Petersburg, haholo-holo ka dinoka le matsha.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Letsha la Onega le boetse le hokahane le Volga, kahoo ho tloha Lewatleng la Caspian ho pholletsa Russia ho ntse ho ka khoneha.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Kgodiseha hore hang fela ha o fihla boema-kepeng dintho tsohle di tla bonahala hantle. O tla kopana le ba bang ba kopang ho nametswa dikepeng mme ba tla ho fa boitsebiso ba bona.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Ha e le hantle o tla be o beha ditsebiso tsa hore o fana ka thuso, o tsamaya boema-kepeng, o ya ho batho ba hlwekisang di-yatch tsa bona, o leka ho kopana le basesisi ba dikepe bareng, jwalo-jwalo.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Leka ho bua le batho ba ba ngata ka moo ho ka kgonehang. Ka moraho ha nako batho bohle ba tla ho tseba mme ba ho fe ditlhahiso tsa hore na ke sekepe sefe se batlang motho.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: O lokela ho kgetha k’hampani ya hao ya difofane ya Frequent Flyer ya selekane ka hloho.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Le hoja o ka nahana hore hoa utlwahala ho ba karolo ya k’hampani ya difofane eo o tsamayang ka yona haholo, o lokela ho tseba hore ditokelo tse fanwang hangata dia fapana mme dintlha tsa ho fofa hangata e ka ba tse ngata haholo tlase ha k’hampani ya difofane e selekaneng se tshwanang.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Dik’hampani tsa difofane tse kang Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar airways le Turkish Airways di ekeditse ditshebeletso tsa tsona haholo Afrika, mme di fana ka dihokahano tsa ho ya ditoropong tsa Afrika tse kgolo tse ngata ka ditheko tse tlase ho feta dik’hampani tsa difofane tsa Europe tse ding.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Turkish Airlines e fofa ho ya dibakeng tse 39 dinaheng tse 30 tsa Afrika ho tloha ka 2014.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Haeba o na le nako e eketsehileng ya leeto, hlola hore kakaretso ya tefo ya hao ya ho ya Africa e fapana jwang le tefo ya lefatshe lohle.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: O seke wa lebala ho kenya ditshenyehelo tse eketsehileng tsa di-visa tse eketsehileng, lekgetho la ho tsamaya, dipalangwang tsa fatshe, jwalo-jwalo, bakeng sa dibaka tseo tsohle tse kantle ho Afrika.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Haeba o batla ho fofa ho pota lefatshe ka ho feletseng Karolong e ka Borwa ya Lefatshe, kgetho ya lefatshe le dibaka tsa ho ya ho tsona e lekanyeditswe ka lebaka la ho kgaello ya ditsela tsa ho tshela lewatle.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Ha ho na tshebedisano ya dik'hamphani tsa difofane e akaretsa dibaka tse tharo tsa ho tshela lewatle Karolong e ka Borwa ya Lefatshe (mme SkyTeam ha e akaretse sebakale ha e le sefe sa ho tshela).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Le ha ho le jwalo, Star Alliance e akaretsa ntho engwe le engwe ntle le Pacific Borwa e ka botjhabela ho tloha Santiago de Chile ho ya Tahiti, eo e leng leeto la sefofane la LATAM Oneworld.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Sefofane sena ha se yona fela kgetho haeba o batla ho tlola Pacifi Borwa le lebopo le ka bophirima la Amerika Borwa. (sheba ka tlase)
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Ka 1994, sebaka sa morabe sa Armenia sa Nagorno-Karabakh se Azerbaijan se ile sa lwana le Maazeri.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Ka tshehetso ya Armenia, rephabliki entjha e ile ya thehwa. Le ha ho le jwalo, ha ho na naha e thehilweng - esita le Armenia - e e amohelang ka se mmuso.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Dikhohlano tsa dipolotiki mabapi le sebaka sena di ntse di tswela pele ho senya dikamano pakeng tsa Armenia le Azerbaijan.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Canal District (ka se Dutch: Grachtengordel) ke setereke se tsebahalang haholo sa lekholong la bo-17 la lilemo se potolohileng Binnenstad ea Amsterdam.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Setereke sohle se khethilwe e le Sebaka sa Bohlokwahadi Lefatsheng sa UNESCO bakeng sa boleng ba sona bo ikgethang ba setso le ba histori, mme theko ya sona ya thepa e ka hare ha tse phahameng ka ho fetisisa naheng.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre, e bolelang Dinaha tse Hlano, e na le metsana e mehlano e lebopong la Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza le Monterosso e sebakeng sa Italy sa Liguria.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Di thathamisitswe Lethathamong la Dibaka tsa Bohlwahadi Lefatsheng la UNESCO.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Ho theosa le makgolo a dilemo, batho ba nnile ba haha ​​mathule ka hloko dibakeng tse matsutla-tsutla, tse moepa ho ya fihla mafikeng a maholo a shebileng lewatle.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Karolo ya botle ba yona ke kgaello ya meaho ya kgwebo. Ditselana, diterene le dikepe di hokahanya metsana, mme dikoloi ha di kgone ho fihla ho tsona di tswa ka ntle.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Mefuta ya Sefora e buuwang Belgium le Switzerland e fapana hanyenyane ho Sefora se buuwang Fora, le ho ja se tshwana ka ho lekaneng hore sea utlwahala ka ho tshwanang.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Ka ho kgetheha, tsamaiso ya dinomoro ka Sefora sa Belgium le Switzerland ditshobotsi tse ikgethang tse itseng tse fapaneng le Sefora se buuwang Fora, mme tsela ya ho bitsa mantswe a itseng e fapane hanyenyane feela.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Le ha ho le jwalo, batho bohle ba buang Sefora ba Belgium le Switzerland ba tla be ba ithutile Sefora sa motheo sekolong, kahoo ba ka kgona ho ho utlwisisa le haeba o sebedisa tsamaiso ya dinomoro ya Sefora.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Dikarolong tse ngata tsa lefatshe, ho tsoka letsoho ke pontsho e bontshang botswalle, e bolelang hore “dumela”.
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Le ha ho le jwalo, Malaysia, bonyane pakeng tsa batho ba Malaysia dibakeng tsa mahaeng, ho bolela “e tla mona,” ho tshwana le monwana wa bosupa o kobileng ho lebana le mmele, pontsho e sebediswang dinaheng tse itseng tsa Bophirimela, mme e lokela ho sebedisetswa morero oo fela.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Ka ho tshwanang, motsamai wa Brithani a ka bona ho tsoka letsoho ho bontshang ho sadisa hantle ho akarelletsang bohare ba letsoho bo lebelletse motho ya tsokang letshoho (ho e na le motho eo ho tsokuwang letsoho ho yena) e le pontsho ya hore a kgutle.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Dipuo tse thusang ha se tsa nnete kapa dipuo tse hlophisitsweng tse qapilweng ka morero wa ho tsamaisa puisano pakeng tsa batho bao ba neng ba ka eba le bothata ba ho buisana.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Di arohane le dipuo tse tlwaelehileng, tseo e leng tsa tlhaho kapa tsa nnete tse e bang tse buwang haholo ka lebaka le le leng kapa le leng jwaloka tsela ya puisano pakeng tsa batho ba buwang dpuo tse ding.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Ha ho tjhesa, batsamai ba ka bona ho phatsima ho kang metsi ho fanang ka kgopolo ya hore ke metsi (kapa dintho tse ding).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Tsena di ka eba kotsi haeba motsamai a latella ho phatsima ho kang metsi, a senya matla ao e leng letlotlo le metsi a setseng.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Le mahwatata a tjhesang ka ho fetisisa a ka eba a batang ka ho fetisisa bosiu. Ho theoha ha motjheso haholo mmeleng ke kotsi ya nnete ha o se na diaparo tse futhumetseng.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Ka lehlabula, haholo-holo, o tla hloka hore o hlokomele menwang haeba o nka qeto ya ho hahlaula hare morung o nang le metsi.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Le hoja o kganna ka hare ho moru o nang le metsi o tjhesang le o mongobo, metsotswana e mmalwa menyako e butswe ha o kena ka hare ho koloi ke nako e lekaneng hore menwang e kene ka hare ho koloi le wena.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Ntaramane ya dinonyana (Bird flu), kapa e tsejwang semmuso e le avian influenza, e ka tshwaetsa ka bobedi dinonyana le diphoofolo tse anyesang.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Dipeho tse tlaase ho tse dikete di kile tsa behwa ka batho, empa tse ding tsa tsona di qetelletse ka lefu.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Tse ngata di akarelletsa batho ba sebetsang ka dikgoho, empa ho na le kotsi ho bashebelli ba dinonyana.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Ho tlwaelehileng ka Norway ke dikou tse theohelang le diphuka tseo ka tshohanyetso di yang ho sehlaba se phahameng, ho e ka bang se lekanang.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Dihlaba tsena hangata di bitswa “vidde” e bolelang sepakapaka se se nang meedi se sephara, sebaka se bulehilelng se se nang difate.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Rogaland le Agder ka ho tlwaelehileng di bitswa "hei" e bolelang sebaka se bulehileng se senang difate seo hangata se kwahetsweng ke semela se dulang se le setala.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Diqhoqhwane ha dia tsitsa, empa di phallela fatshe ho thaba. Sena se tla baka ho petsoha, mapatso, hoo ka thbelwang ke marokgo a lehlwa.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Mabota le marulelo a mahaha a leqhwa a ka heleha mme ho petsoha ho kwalehe.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Ntshing ya diqhoqhwane ditene tse kgolo di ka tjhopoloha, di wele fatshe mme mohlomong di tlole kapa di pitikele hole le ntshi.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Nako ya bahahlaudi bakeng sa dibaka tsa maralla ka kakaretso e hodimo nakong ya lehlabula la India.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Le ha ho lejwalo, di na le mofuta wa botle o fapaneng le ho kgahlisa ka nako ya mariha, ka dibaka tse ngata tsa maralla tse fumanang boholo ba lehlwa bo lekanetseng mme di fana ka mesebetsi e kang ho thellisa lehlweng le ho thellisa lehlweng ka boto.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Ke difofane tse mmalwa tse sa ntse di fana ka phokoletso ya ditjheho tsa ho palama ha o shwetswe, e leng ho etsang hore ho fokotsehe hanyenyane tjhelete ya ho nka leeto la ho ya lepatong.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Difofane tse fanang ka sena di akarelletsa Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa bakeng sa difofane tse tswang U.S kapa Canda, le WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Memong ohle, o lokela ho etsa tokisetso ka mohala ka ho tobileng le sefofane.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
